name: App

description.zh: 为窗口设置主题，并传给其中的组件。
description.en: Apply a window theme and share it with its components.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

在视图函数开头调用 `nui.App(c, config)`，再把返回的主题传给按钮、卡片等组件。`config` 保存明暗模式和色板，应在创建窗口时初始化。页面中的完整示例包含窗口创建和语言设置。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改按钮文字和颜色，观察卡片中的按钮。
2. 切换页面右上角的明暗模式，查看同一组组件的配色。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Call `nui.App(c, config)` at the start of the view and pass its theme to buttons, cards and other components. Initialize `config` when creating the window to keep appearance and palette choices. The complete example includes window and language setup.

### Try the preview

1. Change the button text and color inside the card.
2. Switch the site appearance to compare light and dark colors.

note.zh: App 只配置当前窗口的主题。创建窗口仍需调用 `mygo.NewWindow`。语言通过 `mygo.App.SetLocale` 设置，作用于整个应用；AppConfig 不提供单窗口语言参数。
note.en: App configures the current window theme. Create the window with `mygo.NewWindow`. Set the application language with `mygo.App.SetLocale`; AppConfig does not provide a per-window locale.

body: nui.Card(c.Key("card"), t, nui.CardOptions{Title: "NuxtUI Go", Description: "Window theme and component defaults"}, func() { nui.Button(c.Key("save"), t, {{label}}, nui.ButtonOptions{AccessibleLabel: cmp.Or({{label}}, "Example action"), Color: {{color}}}) })

name: Theme

description.zh: 统一设置颜色、尺寸和组件样式。
description.en: Set shared colors, sizes and component styles.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`Theme` 保存颜色、字号、间距和组件默认样式。用 `WithComponent` 设置一类组件的默认值；在具体组件的 Options 中设置属性，可覆盖对应默认值。`UI` 用于修改圆角等部件样式。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整颜色、尺寸和样式：第一个按钮使用局部默认值，第二个按钮始终使用 Warning 颜色，第三个展示自定义圆角。
2. 把主色改为 black，再切换明暗模式，查看黑白主色。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`Theme` holds colors, typography, spacing and component defaults. Use `WithComponent` to set defaults for a component type, Options to override them on one instance, and `UI` to customize individual parts.

### Try the preview

1. Change color, size and variant: the first button uses local defaults, the second keeps its Warning color, and the third has custom rounded corners.
2. Select black as the primary color, then switch between light and dark mode.

note.zh: 黑白主色通过 `WithBlackPrimary()` 配置：浅色为黑，深色为白，高对比模式下也保持黑白。应分别应用到浅色和深色主题。ComponentTheme 提供 Color、Size、Variant 和 UI 默认值；其他参数通过组件 Options 设置。默认色板的 Solid 文字通过 4.5:1 对比度检查的范围是高对比模式，普通浅色主色配白字约为 2.22:1。
note.en: Apply `WithBlackPrimary()` to both themes for black in light mode and white in dark mode, including high contrast. ComponentTheme supplies Color, Size, Variant and UI defaults; set other parameters through component Options. The 4.5:1 contrast check for default Solid text covers high-contrast mode. The normal light primary with white text is approximately 2.22:1.

body:
local := t.WithComponent(nui.ComponentButton, nui.ComponentTheme{Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}})
nui.Button(c.Key("local"), local, "Local theme", nui.ButtonOptions{})
nui.Button(c.Key("override"), local, "Instance override", nui.ButtonOptions{Color: nui.Warning})
nui.Button(c.Key("parts"), t, "Part style override", nui.ButtonOptions{UI:nui.Styles{nui.Root:{Radius:nui.Set(float32(999)),PaddingX:nui.Set(float32(24))}}}).AlignSelf(ui.Start)

name: Container

description.zh: 限制内容宽度，并在两侧留出空间。
description.en: Limit content width and add space around it.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

把页面内容放入 `Container` 的回调中，用 `MaxWidth` 限制最大宽度。未设置 `Padding` 时，水平内边距随窗口宽度变化；显式设置后使用固定 DIP 值。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 减小最大宽度，观察内容宽度。
2. 关闭默认内边距后调整自定义值，设为 0 可去掉两侧留白。
3. 编辑草稿，再调整宽度和内边距，草稿会保留。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build content inside `Container` and use `MaxWidth` to limit its width. Unset `Padding` follows the window width; an explicit value uses fixed DIP spacing.

### Try the preview

1. Reduce the maximum width and compare the content width.
2. Turn off default padding and adjust the custom value; zero removes horizontal spacing.
3. Edit the draft, then change width and padding. The draft stays intact.

note.zh: 默认水平内边距在窗口宽度小于 640、640–1023、至少 1024 DIP 时分别为 16、24、32 DIP，并受主题 Density 影响。断点依据窗口宽度。`Padding: nui.Set(0)` 明确去掉内边距；最大宽度未设置时使用 Theme.ContainerWidth。
note.en: Default horizontal padding is 16, 24 or 32 DIP for window widths below 640, from 640 to 1023, or at least 1024 DIP, scaled by theme Density. Breakpoints use the window width. `Padding: nui.Set(0)` removes padding. Unset maximum width uses Theme.ContainerWidth.

name: Main

description.zh: 放置应用的主要内容，并占用剩余空间。
description.en: Place the main application content in the available space.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

在 `Main` 的内容回调中创建页面主体，可与 HeaderLayout、Sidebar 和 FooterLayout 组合。回调会随界面更新而重复执行，业务数据应保存在视图函数外。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标题，查看主内容区中的卡片。
2. 打开完整示例，查看 Main 与窗口主题的组合方式。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build the main page content in the `Main` callback and combine it with HeaderLayout, Sidebar and FooterLayout. The callback runs again as the UI updates, so keep application data outside the view function.

### Try the preview

1. Change the title on the card in the main content area.
2. Open the complete example to see Main used with a window theme.

note.zh: Main 提供布局，不会自动增加滚动条。内容需要滚动时，再组合 ScrollArea 或 MyGo 的 Scroll。
note.en: Main provides layout without scrolling. Add ScrollArea or MyGo Scroll when content needs to scroll.

body: nui.Main(c.Key("main"), t, func(){ nui.Card(c.Key("content"),t,nui.CardOptions{Title:{{label}}},func(){ui.Text(c,"Main application content")}) })

name: Icon

description.zh: 显示 Lucide 矢量图标。
description.en: Display a Lucide vector icon.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

从 `icons/lucide` 包选择图标函数，例如 `lucide.Check()`，将返回的 SVG 传给 `nui.Icon`。通过 Size 设置显示大小，具有独立含义的图标应提供 Label，供辅助技术识别。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 选择不同图标，查看 SVG 的形状。
2. 调整图标大小，观察缩放后的清晰度。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Choose a function from `icons/lucide`, such as `lucide.Check()`, and pass its SVG to `nui.Icon`. Size controls the displayed dimensions. Give a meaningful standalone icon a Label for assistive technology.

### Try the preview

1. Choose a different icon to compare SVG shapes.
2. Change the icon size to see how it scales.

note.zh: 图标大小使用 DIP。图标函数返回共享 SVG，颜色和尺寸通过组件设置，不直接修改 SVG。
note.en: Icon size uses DIP. Icon functions return shared SVGs; set color and size on the component rather than modifying the SVG.

body: nui.Icon(c.Key("icon"), t, {{icon}}, nui.IconOptions{Size:nui.Set(float32({{pixels}})),Label:"Example icon"}).AlignSelf(ui.Start)

name: Button

description.zh: 点击后执行操作，支持图标、加载和禁用状态。
description.en: Run an action with support for icons, loading and disabled states.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 `Button` 设置文字和外观，通过 `.OnClick(...)` 处理点击。点击次数等业务数据放在视图函数外；Loading 和 Disabled 都会阻止用户激活按钮。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击按钮，查看下方计数增加。
2. 更换图标、颜色或尺寸，确认已有计数仍然保留。
3. 开启加载或禁用，再点击按钮，查看计数是否停止变化。
4. 开启前导头像，再选择前导图标或进入加载状态，观察显示优先级。尾部加载图标会保留头像。

启用减少动态效果后改变颜色，再关闭此开关，按钮保持当前颜色。系统减少动态效果设置仍有优先权。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Set button text and appearance with `Button`, then handle activation with `.OnClick(...)`. Keep values such as a click count outside the view function. Loading and Disabled both prevent activation.

### Try the preview

1. Click the button and watch the count below it increase.
2. Change its icon, color or size and confirm the count is retained.
3. Enable loading or disabled, then click again to check that the count stays the same.
4. Enable the avatar, then choose a leading icon or turn loading on to compare precedence. A trailing loader keeps the avatar visible.

Enable reduced motion, change the color, then disable the toggle. The button keeps its current color. System reduced-motion preferences still take precedence.

note.zh: 仅显示图标或头像的按钮必须设置 `AccessibleLabel`。前导图标或前导加载图标优先于 Avatar。加载图标的颜色使用 `UI[Leading].Foreground` 或 `UI[Trailing].Foreground` 配置，Style 中的 TextColor 不改变其绘制颜色。重置示例会清除点击计数。 将 Color 设为 Neutral、Variant 设为 Solid 后，可用自定义背景开关查看 InvertedBackground 的效果；这只修改示例的局部主题。
note.en: An icon-only or avatar-only button requires an `AccessibleLabel`. Leading icons and leading loaders replace Avatar. Set loader colors through `UI[Leading].Foreground` or `UI[Trailing].Foreground`; TextColor in Style does not change their painted color. Resetting clears the click count. Set Color to Neutral and Variant to Solid, then use the custom background toggle to inspect InvertedBackground. This only changes the example’s local theme.

name: Link

description.zh: 以链接样式打开地址或执行导航。
description.en: Open a URL or navigate with a link.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

需要打开外部地址时设置 URL；应用内导航可通过返回元素的 `.OnClick(...)` 处理。Active 标记当前位置，Disabled 禁止操作。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击链接，查看下方的操作次数。
2. 切换当前项和禁用状态，比较外观及点击行为。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Set URL to open an external address, or use `.OnClick(...)` on the returned element for application navigation. Active marks the current location and Disabled prevents activation.

### Try the preview

1. Click the link and check the activation count below it.
2. Toggle active and disabled states to compare appearance and behavior.

note.zh: 本例只增加计数，不打开网页。真实导航由 URL 或应用回调决定。Color 控制激活文字和焦点圈；未激活文字使用 Muted，悬停时使用 Text。
note.en: This example only increments a count. Use URL or an application callback for navigation. Color controls active text and the focus ring; inactive text uses Muted and hovered text uses Text.

body:
nui.Link(c.Key("link"), t, {{label}}, nui.LinkOptions{Color: {{color}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, Active: {{active}}}).OnClick(func(){s.Clicks++})
ui.Textf(c,"Activated %d times",s.Clicks)

name: Badge

description.zh: 用短标签显示状态、分类或数量。
description.en: Show a status, category or count as a small label.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

将要显示的短文字传给 `Badge`，通过 Color、Variant 和 Size 选择外观。Leading 和 Trailing 可在文字两侧添加图标。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标签文字，再选择颜色和图标。
2. 切换样式与方形选项，比较带文字和仅图标的效果。
3. 开启前导头像，再选择图标；显式前导图标会替换头像。清空文字后查看纯图标标签的方形内边距。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass a short label to `Badge` and choose Color, Variant and Size. Leading and Trailing add icons before or after the text.

### Try the preview

1. Change the label, then choose a color and icon.
2. Compare variants and the square option with text or an icon alone.
3. Enable the avatar, then choose an icon to replace it. Clear the label to compare automatic square padding for an icon-only badge.

note.zh: Badge 用于显示信息，需要执行操作时使用 Button。空文字会自动启用 Square；头像未设置 Size 时随 Badge 尺寸调整，显式头像尺寸优先。 将 Color 设为 Neutral、Variant 设为 Solid 后，可用自定义背景开关查看 InvertedBackground 的效果；这只修改示例的局部主题。
note.en: Badge displays information; use Button for actions. An empty label enables Square automatically. Unset avatar Size follows the badge; explicit avatar size takes precedence. Set Color to Neutral and Variant to Solid, then use the custom background toggle to inspect InvertedBackground. This only changes the example’s local theme.

name: Card

description.zh: 把标题、说明和相关内容放在同一张卡片中。
description.en: Group a title, description and related content in a card.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Title 和 Description 设置卡片标题及说明，内容回调用于添加正文和按钮。需要定制标题区或底部操作区时，使用 Header 和 Footer 回调。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标题，查看卡片顶部的变化。
2. 切换 Variant，比较边框和背景样式。
3. 清空标题，只保留描述；再清空描述，观察页头区域移除后的布局。
4. 编辑正文草稿，再清空或恢复标题和描述，已有输入会保留。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use Title and Description for the heading, and the content callback for the body and buttons. Header and Footer callbacks customize the heading area and footer.

### Try the preview

1. Change the title at the top of the card.
2. Switch Variant to compare borders and backgrounds.
3. Clear the title to keep only the description, then clear the description to remove the header.
4. Edit the body draft, then clear or restore the title and description. The draft stays intact.

note.zh: 默认内边距在窗口宽度小于 640 DIP 时为 16 DIP；达到 640 后，水平内边距和正文垂直内边距为 24，页头/页尾垂直内边距仍为 16。只有描述时保留 4 DIP 顶部间距。动态移除页头不会重建正文输入。
note.en: Default padding is 16 DIP below a window width of 640 DIP. At 640 and above, horizontal and body vertical padding are 24; header/footer vertical padding stays 16. A description without a title retains its 4 DIP top margin. Removing the header does not remount the body editor.

body:
nui.Card(c.Key("card"),t,nui.CardOptions{Title:{{label}},Description:{{description}},Variant:{{variant}}},func(){ui.Text(c,"A focused space for related content.");nui.Input(c.Key("draft"),t,&s.Draft,nui.InputOptions{Label:"Card draft"}).FillWidth()})
ui.Text(c,"Draft: "+s.Draft)

name: Alert

description.zh: 在内容区域显示提示、警告或错误信息。
description.en: Display an inline message, warning or error.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Title、Description 和 Icon 说明当前状态。Avatar 存在时优先于 Icon，默认直径为 44 DIP。Actions 构建操作区，默认位于正文下方；Horizontal 将它移到正文旁边。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Review changes，观察操作次数，再切换方向。
2. 打开头像开关，比较头像与图标；修改标题、说明、颜色和样式。
3. 点击关闭按钮，再用 Reopen notice 恢复；分别启用禁用关闭和自定义关闭图标。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Title, Description and Icon describe the status. Avatar takes precedence over Icon and defaults to 44 DIP. Actions builds controls below the body by default; Horizontal moves them beside it.

### Try the preview

1. Click Review changes, watch the count, then change orientation.
2. Enable the avatar and compare it with the icon; edit the title, description, color and variant.
3. Close the notice and use Reopen notice to restore it; try disabling close and changing its icon.

note.zh: OnClose 只通知关闭请求，是否隐藏由应用决定。本例收到请求后隐藏提示，重开时保留操作次数。Close 可配置 ButtonOptions；默认关闭按钮为 MD、Neutral、LinkVariant，关闭图标默认为 X。 将 Color 设为 Neutral、Variant 设为 Solid 后，可用自定义背景开关查看 InvertedBackground 的效果；这只修改示例的局部主题。
note.en: OnClose reports a close request; the application owns visibility. This example hides the notice on request and retains action counts when reopened. Close accepts ButtonOptions; its defaults are MD, Neutral and LinkVariant, with an X icon. Set Color to Neutral and Variant to Solid, then use the custom background toggle to inspect InvertedBackground. This only changes the example’s local theme.

controls.default: Your changes are ready to review.

name: Avatar

description.zh: 显示头像图片、图标或姓名首字母。
description.en: Display an image, icon or name initials as an avatar.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Avatar 按图片、图标、Text、Alt 首字母的顺序选择内容。图片在组件外加载并解码；加载失败时传 nil，组件继续使用回退内容。需要角标时用 Chip 包裹，Inset 设为 true 可将角标放在头像边缘内侧。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入姓名，再设置回退文字和图标，比较内容优先级。
2. 切换尺寸、颜色和角标。
3. 在完整参数中为 Image 选择图片，打开 64 DIP 根容器开关，查看图片如何填满自定义尺寸。Body 部件可配置图片透明度等外观。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Avatar chooses an image, icon, Text, then initials from Alt. Load and decode images outside the component; pass nil on failure to use fallback content. Wrap it in Chip with Inset set to true to place a status chip inside the avatar edge.

### Try the preview

1. Enter a name, then set fallback text and an icon to compare priority.
2. Change size, color and the chip.
3. Choose an Image in the full parameter editor and enable the 64 DIP root to see the image fill the custom size. Body styles control image appearance such as opacity.

note.zh: Alt 优先作为图片的可访问名称，没有 Alt 时使用 Text。XS–XL 直径为 24–40 DIP；64 DIP 开关演示自定义根尺寸，文字和图标仍随 Size。网络下载、缓存、失败重试与 HTML 图片属性由应用或对应平台负责。
note.en: Alt supplies the accessible image name, falling back to Text. XS–XL diameters range from 24 to 40 DIP. The 64 DIP toggle demonstrates a custom root size; text and icons still follow Size. Network loading, caching, retries and HTML image attributes belong to the application or platform.

body: nui.Chip(c.Key("chip"),t,nui.ChipOptions{Hidden:!{{chip}},Inset:true,Color:nui.Success},func(){nui.Avatar(c.Key("avatar"),t,nui.AvatarOptions{Alt:{{label}},Text:{{text}},Icon:{{icon}},Color:{{color}},Size:{{size}},Style:func(slot nui.Slot,e ui.Element){if slot==nui.Root && {{enlarge}} { e.Size(64,64) }}})}).AlignSelf(ui.Start)

name: AvatarGroup

description.zh: 排列多个头像，并显示未展开的人数。
description.en: Arrange several avatars and show how many remain hidden.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

为每个 AvatarItem 提供稳定、唯一的用户 ID 和头像配置。Max 限制显示数量，超出的头像用 `+n` 表示；Size 和 Color 为未单独配置的头像提供默认值。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 将显示上限设为 1 或 2，观察剩余人数。
2. 调整尺寸和颜色，查看三个示例头像的组合效果。
3. 点击 Reverse avatars，检查显示顺序与剩余人数，再打开统一成员样式，比较普通头像和 `+n` 的外框。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Give each AvatarItem a stable, unique user ID and avatar options. Max limits the visible avatars and represents the rest as `+n`. Size and Color supply defaults for items without their own settings.

### Try the preview

1. Set the visible limit to 1 or 2 and check the remaining count.
2. Change size and color to compare the three sample avatars.
3. Click Reverse avatars to check order and the remaining count, then enable Member style to compare regular and `+n` avatar outlines.

note.zh: Max 未设置或小于等于 0 时显示全部头像。动态用户列表使用用户 ID，避免使用排序后会变化的下标。 Item 对应各头像根，包括溢出头像；Item.BorderWidth / BorderColor 配置外侧分隔环，显式 BorderWidth=0 可移除。
note.en: An unset Max or a value at or below zero shows all avatars. Use user IDs rather than positions in a sortable list. Item targets each avatar root, including overflow. Item.BorderWidth and BorderColor control the outer separator ring; explicit BorderWidth=0 removes it.

name: Chip

description.zh: 在头像等内容的角落添加数量或状态标记。
description.en: Add a count or status marker to the corner of other content.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

在 Chip 的内容回调中创建主体，通过 Text、Color、Position 和 Inset 配置角标。Hidden 只隐藏标记；内容回调为 nil 时，角标独立显示。左右位置采用物理方向，不随 RTL 镜像。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Notifications，确认角标不会阻挡按钮；隐藏角标后再点击，观察次数。
2. 切换四角位置和 Inset，比较内外边缘。
3. 输入较长文字并启用自定义文字样式，再切换独立显示。
4. 将颜色设为 Neutral，开启自定义 Neutral 背景，检查局部主题颜色。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build the host in Chip’s content callback and configure Text, Color, Position and Inset. Hidden removes only the marker. A nil content callback renders a standalone chip. Left and right are physical positions and do not mirror in RTL.

### Try the preview

1. Click Notifications to check that the marker does not block the button; hide the marker and click again to watch the count.
2. Try all four corners and Inset to compare inside and outside placement.
3. Enter longer text, enable Styled text, then try Standalone.
4. Set Color to Neutral and enable Custom neutral background to check the local theme color.

note.zh: 文字宽度按 Indicator 的 UI 字体、字号、字重与水平内边距计算。Style 在测量后执行；通过 Style 改字号时也需调整尺寸。本例的自定义文字样式同时增大高度。数量或在线状态应写入主体的可访问名称；角标本身不处理点击。
note.en: Text width uses Indicator UI font, size, weight and horizontal padding. Style runs after measurement; size changes made there also need explicit dimensions. This example increases height for Styled text. Include meaningful counts or status in the host’s accessible name; the marker itself does not handle clicks.

name: Separator

description.zh: 用分隔线区分内容，可添加文字或图标。
description.en: Separate content with a line, label or icon.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

通过 Orientation 选择横线或竖线，Label 在分隔线中显示文字。Size 调整线宽，Color 设置颜色；实际长度由容器和组件尺寸决定。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改文字和颜色，查看分隔线中间的内容。
2. 切换方向，再调整尺寸，比较线条的方向与粗细。
3. 清空 Label，开启头像，查看默认 20 DIP 头像；再尝试三种内容位置和线型。
4. 开启输入内容，编辑草稿并切换位置、方向，确认输入状态保留。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use Orientation for a horizontal or vertical line and Label to insert text. Size adjusts line thickness and Color sets its color. The container and component dimensions determine its length.

### Try the preview

1. Change the label and color in the divider.
2. Switch orientation and size to compare direction and thickness.
3. Clear Label and enable Avatar to see the default 20 DIP avatar; try the three content positions and line types.
4. Enable Editor content, edit the draft and change position or orientation to check that input state is retained.

note.zh: 内容优先级为 Content、Label、Icon、Avatar。纵向默认高度为 48 DIP，本例显式设为 160 DIP，为长标签和输入内容留出空间。当前为装饰性分隔线；MyGo 没有静态 separator 可访问角色，不提供不生效的 Decorative 参数。
note.en: Content takes precedence over Label, Icon and Avatar. Vertical height defaults to 48 DIP; this example explicitly uses 160 DIP for long labels and editor content. This is a decorative divider: MyGo has no static separator accessibility role, so no ineffective Decorative option is exposed.

name: Kbd

description.zh: 把快捷键显示为按键提示。
description.en: Display a keyboard shortcut as key labels.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

将键名按顺序传给 Kbd，例如 `[]string{"CmdOrCtrl", "K"}`。CmdOrCtrl 按目标平台显示 Ctrl 或 ⌘；command、win 始终显示 ⌘、⊞。组件只显示提示，不注册快捷键。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 切换目标平台，比较主要修饰键。
2. 在完整参数的按键列表中输入 command、win 或普通键名，查看符号与大写文字。
3. 调整颜色、样式和尺寸；SM / MD / LG 是标准尺寸，XS / XL 分别沿用 SM / LG。
4. 将颜色和样式设为 Neutral / Solid，开启自定义背景。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass key names in order, such as `[]string{"CmdOrCtrl", "K"}`. CmdOrCtrl displays Ctrl or ⌘ for the target platform; command and win always display ⌘ and ⊞. Kbd displays hints without registering shortcuts.

### Try the preview

1. Change Platform to compare the primary modifier.
2. Enter command, win or ordinary key names in the full key-list editor to inspect symbols and uppercase text.
3. Change color, variant and size. SM / MD / LG are standard sizes; XS / XL reuse SM / LG.
4. Set Neutral / Solid and enable the custom background.

note.zh: Kbd 只显示提示，不注册快捷键。实际按键操作需由应用单独绑定。 将 Color 设为 Neutral、Variant 设为 Solid 后，可用自定义背景开关查看 InvertedBackground 的效果；这只修改示例的局部主题。
note.en: Kbd displays a hint; it does not register the shortcut. Bind keyboard actions separately in the application. Set Color to Neutral and Variant to Solid, then use the custom background toggle to inspect InvertedBackground. This only changes the example’s local theme.

body:
if {{customNeutral}} {t.InvertedBackground=ui.Hex("#7e22ce");if t.Dark {t.InvertedBackground=ui.Hex("#c084fc")}}
nui.Kbd(c.Key("shortcut"),t,[]string{"CmdOrCtrl","K"},nui.KbdOptions{Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Platform: {{platform}}}).AlignSelf(ui.Start)

name: Skeleton

description.zh: 在数据加载时显示内容占位。
description.en: Show a placeholder while content is loading.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Width、Height 是 Go 原生尺寸参数，未设置时为 160×16 DIP，默认高度遵循文字缩放。显式 0 保持为 0；需要填满父容器时，在返回元素上调用 FillWidth。应用根据加载状态决定是否显示占位。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整宽高和圆角，或将宽高设为 0。
2. 打开直角覆盖，验证 Style 中的 Radius(0) 优先于 UI 圆角。
3. 关闭动画，再恢复未设置，对比静态与默认脉冲效果。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Width and Height are native Go dimensions. Unset values default to 160×16 DIP; default height follows text scaling. Explicit zero remains zero. Call FillWidth on the returned element to use the parent width. The application decides when to show the placeholder.

### Try the preview

1. Adjust dimensions and radius, or set a dimension to zero.
2. Enable square corners to verify that Style Radius(0) overrides the UI radius.
3. Disable animation, then restore the unset value to compare a static placeholder with the default pulse.

note.zh: 动画只改变占位背景的透明度。系统或主题启用减少动态效果时保持静止；移出可见区域或卸载后不再请求动画帧。背景颜色通过 UI.Root.Background 配置；Style.Background 只设置底层表面，不会替换自绘脉冲颜色。原生 status 角色不等同于 Web 的 aria-busy / alert 通知。
note.en: Animation changes the placeholder background opacity. System or theme reduced motion keeps it still; leaving the visible area or unmounting stops animation frames. Set the pulse color with UI.Root.Background; Style.Background sets the underlying surface without replacing the drawn pulse color. The native status role does not reproduce Web aria-busy / alert announcements.

body: nui.Skeleton(c.Key("skeleton"), t, nui.SkeletonOptions{Width: nui.Set(float32({{width}})), Height: nui.Set(float32({{height}})), Animate: {{animate}}, Decoration: nui.Decoration{UI: nui.Styles{nui.Root: {Radius: nui.Set(float32({{radius}}))}}, Style: func(_ nui.Slot, e ui.Element) { if {{square}} { e.Radius(0) } }}})

name: Progress

description.zh: 显示已完成的进度，或表示任务仍在处理中。
description.en: Show completed progress or indicate that work is ongoing.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

传入完成量，Max 默认为 100。数值先限制在 0 到 Max，视觉百分比四舍五入到整数；Indeterminate 为 true 时忽略完成量，显示半条轨道长的移动指示器。返回元素的 Value 可以提供工作单位等可访问值说明，屏幕上需要百分比文字时由应用组合 Text。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改完成量与最大值，比较填充比例。
2. 切换方向和反向填充；水平布局还会遵循文字方向。
3. 选择 Neutral 并启用自定义中性背景，比较深浅主题。
4. 启用进度未知，开关动画。减少动态效果时，指示器静止在中间。

关闭动画后修改进度，再开启动画，填充保持当前值。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass the completed amount; Max defaults to 100. Values are clamped to 0–Max and visual percentages are rounded to integers. Indeterminate ignores the amount and displays a moving half-track indicator. Use Value on the returned element for accessible work-unit text; compose a Text element when an on-screen percentage is needed.

### Try the preview

1. Change the amount and maximum to compare proportions.
2. Change orientation and inversion; horizontal progress also follows text direction.
3. Select Neutral and enable the custom neutral background in both themes.
4. Enable indeterminate progress and toggle animation. Reduced motion keeps the indicator centered.

Disable animation, change the amount, then enable animation; the fill retains its current value.

note.zh: 显式 Max 必须是有限正数，否则会 panic；非有限完成量按 0 处理。未知进度使用两秒轮播，未提供其他 CSS 动画预设或步骤数组。自定义中性背景只影响 Neutral；Indicator.Background 可直接指定填充色。示例不会启动真实任务。
note.en: An explicit Max must be finite and positive or the component panics. Non-finite amounts become zero. Unknown progress uses a two-second carousel; other CSS animation presets and step arrays are not provided. The custom background affects Neutral only; Indicator.Background directly sets the fill color. This example does not start a task.

body:
if {{customNeutral}} { t.InvertedBackground = ui.Hex("#7e22ce"); if t.Dark { t.InvertedBackground = ui.Hex("#c084fc") } }
nui.Progress(c.Key("progress"), t, {{value}}, nui.ProgressOptions{Label: "Progress", Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Max: nui.Set(float64({{max}})), Indeterminate: {{indeterminate}}, Orientation: {{orientation}}, Inverted: {{inverted}}, Animate: {{animate}}})

name: ProgressGroup

description.zh: 在同一条进度轨道中展示多项完成量。
description.en: Show several amounts within one progress track.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

每个 ProgressSegment 使用唯一、非空 ID，Value 表示完成量，Label 和 Icon 用于图例。没有图标时显示色点；Build 可以自定义图例内容。通过项目 UI 配置 Segment、Item、Leading、Label、Trailing；整个组的 List 配置图例列表，Indicator 配置轨道。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 切换图标和尺寸，比较图例字号、图标与色点。
2. 修改 Max，查看空余空间和总量超限后的比例。
3. 选择 Neutral 并启用自定义中性背景；Code 继承组颜色，其他项目保持显式颜色。
4. 启用自定义分段颜色，将 Tests 轨道改为橙色；项目 UI 不改变其他分段。
5. 切换方向或隐藏图例，观察轨道布局。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Give each ProgressSegment a unique non-empty ID. Value is the completed amount; Label and Icon describe it in the legend. Items without an icon show a dot. Build can provide custom legend content. Item UI supports Segment, Item, Leading, Label and Trailing; group List styles the legend and Indicator styles the track.

### Try the preview

1. Toggle icons and sizes to compare legend fonts, icons and dots.
2. Change Max to inspect unused space and proportional overflow.
3. Select Neutral and enable the custom background. Code inherits the group color; other items retain explicit colors.
4. Enable the custom segment color to make the Tests fill orange without changing other segments.
5. Switch orientation or hide the legend.

note.zh: 每段先限制在 0–Max，总量超限时按比例缩短；图例百分比仍以 Max 为分母。未设置 Max 时为 100，显式值必须是有限正数。Height≤0 使用 160 DIP。Build 同步构建图例，内部控件按项目 ID 保留身份；隐藏图例会卸载这些控件。状态文字由应用另外组合。
note.en: Each value is clamped to 0–Max. Overflow shrinks segments proportionally while legend percentages remain relative to Max. Unset Max is 100; explicit maxima must be finite and positive. Height≤0 uses 160 DIP. Build synchronously constructs legend content; child controls retain identity by item ID. Hiding the legend unmounts them. Compose status text separately.

name: Empty

description.zh: 说明当前为何没有内容，并提供下一步操作。
description.en: Explain an empty state and offer a next action.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Title 和 Description 说明空状态；可用 Icon 或 Avatar 展示前导内容，通过 Actions 和 Footer 添加操作与补充说明。Loading 默认使用旋转加载图标，主题或系统减少动态效果会停止旋转。

Header 替换整个默认页头，Leading 仅替换前导内容，Body 替换默认操作区。各区域按稳定标识构建，显示或隐藏页头不会替换操作区中的控件。默认内边距随窗口宽度采用 16 / 24 / 32 DIP。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 切换头像、加载和图标颜色，比较显示优先级。
2. 点击 Create project，观察底部计数。
3. 启用自定义正文后，改用 Complete custom body，计数继续累加。
4. 启用自定义页头，观察标题与头像被替换。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Title and Description explain the empty state. Use Icon or Avatar for leading content, and Actions or Footer for controls and supporting content. Loading uses a spinning icon; theme or system reduced motion stops rotation.

Header replaces the default header, Leading replaces only its leading content, and Body replaces the default action area. Stable section identities preserve action controls when the header changes. Default padding follows window width at 16 / 24 / 32 DIP.

### Try the preview

1. Toggle avatar, loading and icon color to compare content priority.
2. Click Create project and watch the footer count.
3. Enable the custom body and use Complete custom body; the same count continues.
4. Enable the custom header to replace the title and avatar.

note.zh: 按钮在示例中更新本地计数，不创建真实项目。Avatar.Image 优先于图标；显式 Avatar.Icon 优先于 Empty 的图标和加载图标。其他情况下 Loading 会替换普通图标或文字头像。默认标题提供二级标题语义；原生没有等价的 aria-busy 元数据。加载图标颜色请使用 UI.Leading.Foreground，Style 的晚期 TextColor 不改变已解析的自绘颜色。
note.en: Buttons update a local counter without creating a real project. Avatar.Image takes precedence over icons; explicit Avatar.Icon takes precedence over Empty icons, including the loading icon. Otherwise Loading replaces the regular icon or text avatar. The default title is a level-two heading; native aria-busy metadata is unavailable. Set UI.Leading.Foreground for loading color; a later Style TextColor call does not alter the resolved drawing color.

name: User

description.zh: 一起显示用户头像、姓名和简短说明。
description.en: Show a user’s avatar, name and short description.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Name 和 Description 展示用户信息，Avatar 配置头像。Avatar 全为空时不显示头像；Chip 仅在默认头像存在时显示，尺寸随 User，位置保持内嵌。Leading 可替换整个头像区域，Body 可替换默认姓名和说明。

提供 OnActivate 后，User 作为原生按钮响应鼠标、Enter 和 Space。悬停或键盘焦点会强调文字并放大头像；减少动态效果会取消缩放过渡。导航目标由应用在回调中处理。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 开关头像和角标，比较显示条件。
2. 清空姓名，确认说明前没有多余间距。
3. 启用可激活，点击或按 Enter / Space，观察计数；禁用后再次尝试。
4. 切换纵向、尺寸和自定义内容，确认计数保留。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Name and Description present user information; Avatar configures the image or fallback. Empty Avatar options show no avatar. Chip appears only with the default avatar, follows User size and stays inset. Leading replaces the avatar area; Body replaces the default name and description.

OnActivate makes User a native button for pointer, Enter and Space activation. Hover or keyboard focus emphasizes text and scales the avatar; reduced motion removes the scale transition. Handle navigation in the application callback.

### Try the preview

1. Toggle avatar and chip to compare display conditions.
2. Clear the name and check that no extra space precedes the description.
3. Enable interactivity, click or press Enter / Space and inspect the count; try again while disabled.
4. Change orientation, size and custom content while retaining the count.

note.zh: User.Size 覆盖 Avatar.Size、Chip.Size，Chip.Inset 固定为 true。角标不截获点击；业务状态应包含在姓名、说明或可访问名称中。自定义内容替换默认文字后，可激活项仍应提供 Name。原生没有 Nuxt 路由、target 或自动 URL 打开行为。
note.en: User.Size overrides Avatar.Size and Chip.Size; Chip.Inset is always true. The chip does not intercept clicks; include meaningful status in the name, description or accessible name. Interactive custom content should still provide Name. Native User has no Nuxt routing, target or automatic URL opening.

name: Input

description.zh: 编辑单行文字，支持只读、清空和加载状态。
description.en: Edit one line of text with read-only, clear and loading options.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

将字符串指针传给 `Input`，组件会更新绑定的值。字符串应保存在视图函数外，避免每次界面更新都重置输入。Label 提供控件名称，Placeholder 是输入前的提示。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入一段文字，查看下方的 Value。
2. 调整尺寸、主题或网站语言，确认输入仍保留。
3. 开启只读后尝试选择和复制，再开启禁用比较操作差异。
4. 开启头像和加载，比较前导加载与尾部加载：前导加载替换头像，尾部加载保留头像。尝试修改加载颜色并继续输入。
5. 按 Enter 或点击清空，查看提交和清空计数。
6. 选择 Neutral 并开启自定义 Neutral 背景，聚焦输入框；None 样式也可通过强调边框开关显示颜色。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass a string pointer to `Input`; the component updates that value. Keep the string outside the view function so UI updates do not reset it. Label names the control and Placeholder gives an input hint.

### Try the preview

1. Enter some text and check Value below the input.
2. Change size, theme or site language and confirm the text remains.
3. Enable read-only and try selecting or copying, then compare with disabled.
4. Enable avatar and loading. A leading loader replaces the avatar; a trailing loader keeps it. Change the loader color and keep typing.
5. Press Enter or clear the value and check the submit and clear counts.
6. Select Neutral with a custom neutral background and focus the field. Highlight can also show a ring with the None variant.

note.zh: ReadOnly 允许选择和复制，但禁止编辑；Disabled 禁止交互。Loading 显示加载图标，输入框仍可编辑。 头像和加载位置切换不会重置文字、焦点或选区。LoadingTrailing 遇到显式 Leading 图标时仍在前方加载。MaxLength 按 UTF-16 单元限制用户插入；外部赋值不会自动截断或触发 OnChange。
note.en: ReadOnly allows selection and copying but prevents editing. Disabled prevents interaction. Loading shows an indicator while allowing editing. Switching avatar or loader placement preserves text, focus and selection. An explicit Leading icon takes priority over LoadingTrailing. MaxLength limits inserted UTF-16 units; external assignments are neither truncated nor reported through OnChange.

state: Value string; Changes, Submits, Clears int

name: Textarea

description.zh: 编辑多行文字，可随内容增加高度。
description.en: Edit multiple lines and optionally grow with the content.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Textarea 绑定字符串，通用输入选项放在嵌入的 InputOptions 中。Rows 设置基础行数，AutoResize 允许随换行增长，MaxRows 可限制最高行数。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入多行文字，调整基础行数。
2. 开启自动调整高度，继续换行并观察输入框高度。
3. 将最多行数设为 4，继续输入，确认达到上限后在框内滚动；0 表示不限。
4. 开启头像、加载和尾部加载，再修改加载颜色，观察附件与第一行对齐；继续输入或点击清空检查计数。
5. 选择 Neutral 和自定义 Neutral 背景，比较聚焦外观；切换 None 后开启强调边框。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Textarea binds a string and takes shared input settings through InputOptions. Rows sets the base line count, AutoResize grows with new lines, and MaxRows can cap that growth.

### Try the preview

1. Enter several lines and change the base row count.
2. Enable automatic height, then add more lines and watch the field grow.
3. Set maximum rows to 4 and keep typing; content scrolls inside after the limit. Zero removes the cap.
4. Enable avatar, loading and trailing loader, then change the loader color. Accessories align with the first line. Keep typing or clear the text to check the counts.
5. Choose Neutral and a custom neutral background to compare focus styling. Enable Highlight with None to show a ring.

note.zh: 文字保存在视图函数外。行数、头像和加载位置变化保留编辑状态。Rows≤0 使用 3 行；MaxRows 只在 AutoResize 时生效，≤0 表示不限，小于 Rows 时按 Rows 处理。Enter 和 Shift+Enter 换行，不触发 OnSubmit；共享 Password 字段对多行输入不生效。没有拖拽调整高度手柄。
note.en: Keep text outside the view function. Changes to rows, avatar or loader placement preserve editing state. Rows≤0 uses 3. MaxRows applies only with AutoResize: ≤0 means unlimited and values below Rows use Rows. Enter and Shift+Enter insert lines without OnSubmit; the shared Password field has no effect on multiline input. There is no drag-to-resize handle.

name: FormField

description.zh: 给输入控件添加标签、帮助文字和错误提示。
description.en: Add a label, help text and errors to an input.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

把输入控件放进 `FormField` 的回调，并使用回调传入的主题。这样标签、尺寸、禁用和错误状态才能正确关联到输入控件。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标签和错误信息，查看它们在输入框周围的位置。
2. 点击标签，确认焦点进入输入框；再切换必填和禁用状态。
3. 清空标签、字段说明和右侧提示，确认输入框上方没有空行；再恢复标签并切换横向排列。
4. 开启区域样式，观察 Header 和 Body 的背景与内边距。输入后改变方向或错误提示，检查内容保留。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build the input inside the `FormField` callback and use the theme passed to that callback. This connects the label and passes size, disabled and error state to the input.

### Try the preview

1. Change the label and error text to see where they appear.
2. Click the label to focus the input, then toggle required and disabled.
3. Clear the label, description and hint to remove the heading area, then restore the label and switch to horizontal layout.
4. Enable region styles to compare Header and Body backgrounds and padding. Edit the value, then change direction or error text and confirm it is preserved.

note.zh: Required 显示必填标记，不执行校验。需要检查输入值时，使用 Form.Validate 或应用自己的校验逻辑。 没有 Label 时不单独绘制星号，必填说明仍传给控件。Error 优先于 Help；标签定位第一个绑定的控件。Hint 单独显示是原生扩展。字段名精确匹配，不提供 errorPattern 或字段级延迟校验。
note.en: Required displays a required marker without validating the value. Use Form.Validate or application validation to check input. Without Label, no isolated asterisk is drawn, while the required description still reaches the control. Error takes priority over Help; the label targets the first bound control. A standalone Hint is a native extension. Field names match exactly; errorPattern and per-field delayed validation are not provided.

controls.default: Use a name your team will recognize.

name: FieldGroup

description.zh: 把相关输入框和按钮连成一组。
description.en: Join related inputs and buttons into one group.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

通过 FieldGroupItem 列表提供内容，每项包含稳定 ID 和 Build 回调。组统一处理尺寸、禁用和外侧圆角，组内仍保留各控件的键盘顺序。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 在搜索框输入文字，再切换纵向排列。
2. 调整尺寸或开启禁用，查看输入框和按钮一起变化。
3. 选中输入文字，切换交换顺序，确认编辑内容保留；点击 Search 查看提交结果。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Provide FieldGroupItems with stable IDs and Build callbacks. The group coordinates size, disabled state and outer corners while keeping each control’s keyboard order.

### Try the preview

1. Type in the search field, then switch to vertical layout.
2. Change size or enable disabled to see both controls update.
3. Select the input text and reverse item order to check that editing is preserved, then click Search to see the submitted value.

note.zh: Search 显示本次提交的文字，不连接搜索服务。每项必须提供唯一、非空 ID 和 Build。Size 优先使用组实例、组主题及外层字段配置，子控件的显式尺寸仍可独立设置。共享边缘的焦点环可能被后绘制的相邻控件遮住；MyGo 没有公开 z-index。
note.en: Search displays the submitted text without connecting to a search service. Each item needs a unique nonempty ID and a Build function. Size follows the group instance, group theme and enclosing field; explicit child sizes remain independent. Later-painted neighbors can cover the shared edge of a focus ring; MyGo has no public z-index.

name: Checkbox

description.zh: 勾选单个选项，也可表示部分选中的状态。
description.en: Toggle an option or represent a partially selected state.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Checkbox 绑定 `*bool`；CheckboxTri 绑定 CheckState，支持 Unchecked、Checked 和 Indeterminate。CheckedIcon 设置选中图标，IndeterminateIcon 设置部分选中图标。隐藏指示器时，显式 CheckedIcon 显示在标签上方；未设置时不显示默认图标。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 开启自定义图标，观察下方部分选中状态使用加号。点击 Mixed selection 后变为选中图标；Reset mixed state 恢复部分选中。
2. 将样式设为 card，指示器设为 hidden，观察图标位于文字上方。关闭自定义图标后只显示文字。
3. 用鼠标或 Space 切换选择，查看 Enabled 和 Changes；修改图标、样式和尺寸不会增加变更次数。

必填标记由 FormField.Required 提供。它显示星号并补充辅助技术说明；提交校验仍由 FormState 的校验规则负责。卡片的 UI.Root 样式可覆盖状态外观，Style 回调最后应用。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Checkbox binds a `*bool`; CheckboxTri binds CheckState with Unchecked, Checked and Indeterminate values. CheckedIcon customizes the checked icon and IndeterminateIcon customizes the mixed icon. With a hidden indicator, an explicit CheckedIcon appears above the label; no default icon is inserted.

### Try the preview

1. Enable custom icons to show a plus for the mixed state. Click Mixed selection to check it, then use Reset mixed state to restore it.
2. Select card and hidden to place icons above text. Turn custom icons off to show text only.
3. Toggle with the pointer or Space and inspect Enabled and Changes. Icon, appearance and size updates do not increase the change counts.

FormField.Required provides the asterisk and an accessibility description. Submission validation still belongs to FormState validators. UI.Root styles can override card state appearance; Style callbacks run last.

note.zh: 选择值应保存在视图函数外。父子复选框之间的联动由应用计算。 Loading 是共享类型中的兼容字段，对 Checkbox 不生效；Switch 才使用加载状态。 ChoiceTable 是单个 Checkbox 的 Go 原生扩展。
note.en: Keep selection values outside the view function. The application computes relationships between parent and child checkboxes. Loading is retained in the shared options for compatibility and is not used by Checkbox; it applies to Switch. ChoiceTable is a Go native extension for a standalone Checkbox.

state: Value bool; Mixed nui.CheckState; Changes, MixedChanges int

name: Switch

description.zh: 打开或关闭一项设置。
description.en: Turn a setting on or off.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Switch 绑定非 nil 的 `*bool`。CheckedIcon 和 UncheckedIcon 分别设置两种状态的图标；Loading 为 true 时显示 LoadingIcon，默认使用加载图标，并禁止切换。解除加载不会自动更改绑定值。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 开启自定义图标，用鼠标和 Space 切换，观察 Enabled 和 Changes。
2. 开启 loading，尝试点击开关和 Sync policy 标签，值与次数均不变；关闭 loading 后恢复操作。
3. 切换 highlight，比较轨道描边。更改图标、颜色和尺寸不增加变更次数。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Switch binds a non-nil `*bool`. CheckedIcon and UncheckedIcon customize each state. Loading displays LoadingIcon, using the default loader when unset, and blocks toggling. Completing loading does not change the value.

### Try the preview

1. Enable custom icons, then toggle with the pointer and Space while watching Enabled and Changes.
2. Enable loading and try the switch and Sync policy label. Neither changes the value or count. Disable loading to restore input.
3. Toggle highlight to compare the track border. Icon, color and size changes do not increase the change count.

note.zh: 选择值由应用持久保存。Variant 和 Indicator 是 Go 原生扩展。滑块位置即时更新；加载图标遵循减少动态效果设置。FormField 提供必填标记，提交约束由表单校验规则处理。
note.en: The application retains the selected value. Variant and Indicator are Go native extensions. The thumb updates immediately; the loader respects reduced motion. FormField provides the required marker, while form validators enforce submission rules.

name: CheckboxGroup

description.zh: 从一组可见选项中选择多项。
description.en: Choose multiple items from a visible set of options.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

CheckboxGroup 绑定 `*[]T`，勾选时追加值，取消时移除值。Option.Value 必须唯一，显示文字可以重复。Option.Icon 设置项目图标；隐藏指示器后，图标位于标签上方。FormField.Label 可作为组标题。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 选择 card 和 hidden，查看各项目图标；关闭项目图标后只显示文字。
2. 用方向键移动，观察焦点、Selected 和 Changes。多选组移动时不改变选择，按 Space 才切换，默认到边界停止。
3. 修改 loop 比较边界行为；横向使用左右键，纵向使用上下键。Reverse choices 重排项目，不清空选择，也不增加变更次数。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

CheckboxGroup binds a `*[]T`, appending checked values and removing unchecked values. Option.Value must be unique; labels may repeat. Option.Icon customizes item icons, placing them above the label when the indicator is hidden. FormField.Label provides a visible group heading.

### Try the preview

1. Choose card and hidden to see item icons. Turn item icons off to display text only.
2. Use arrows while watching focus, Selected and Changes. Checkbox navigation only moves focus; Space toggles selection. It stops at the boundary by default.
3. Toggle loop to compare boundary behavior. Horizontal groups use Left/Right, vertical groups use Up/Down. Reverse choices reorders items without clearing selection or emitting changes.

note.zh: Max 未设置时不限数量，Set(0) 禁止新增选择。达限的未选项仍可聚焦；取消已选项后可以继续勾选。项目图标用于选中指示器或隐藏模式的标签。Loop 使用 `Optional[bool]`，可显式设置 false。Option.Build 在选项组中不生效。
note.en: Unset Max has no limit; Set(0) prevents new selections. Items remain focusable at the limit, and unchecking an item allows another selection. Item icons customize checked indicators or hidden-mode labels. Loop uses `Optional[bool]` and accepts explicit false. Option.Build is not used by choice groups.

name: RadioGroup

description.zh: 从一组可见选项中选择一项。
description.en: Choose one item from a visible set of options.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

RadioGroup 绑定 `*T`，每次选中一项。Option.Value 必须唯一，显示文字可以重复。Option.Icon 设置项目图标；隐藏指示器后，图标位于标签上方。FormField.Label 可作为组标题。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 选择 card 和 hidden，查看各项目图标；关闭项目图标后只显示文字。
2. 用方向键移动，观察焦点、Selected 和 Changes。单选组移动时会选择项目，默认循环。
3. 修改 loop 比较边界行为；横向使用左右键，纵向使用上下键。Reverse choices 重排项目，不清空选择，也不增加变更次数。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

RadioGroup binds a `*T` and selects one item. Option.Value must be unique; labels may repeat. Option.Icon customizes item icons, placing them above the label when the indicator is hidden. FormField.Label provides a visible group heading.

### Try the preview

1. Choose card and hidden to see item icons. Turn item icons off to display text only.
2. Use arrows while watching focus, Selected and Changes. Radio navigation selects an item and loops by default.
3. Toggle loop to compare boundary behavior. Horizontal groups use Left/Right, vertical groups use Up/Down. Reverse choices reorders items without clearing selection or emitting changes.

note.zh: Max 是共享类型中保留的兼容字段，对 RadioGroup 不生效。可见指示器始终显示单选圆点，项目图标只在隐藏指示器时显示。Loop 使用 `Optional[bool]`，可显式设置 false。Option.Build 在选项组中不生效。
note.en: Max is retained in the shared options but is not used by RadioGroup. Visible indicators remain radio dots; item icons appear only when the indicator is hidden. Loop uses `Optional[bool]` and accepts explicit false. Option.Build is not used by choice groups.

state: Value string; Reverse bool; Changes int

name: Slider

description.zh: 拖动滑块调整一个数值或一段范围。
description.en: Adjust a value or range by dragging sliders.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Slider 绑定一个 `*float64`；RangeSlider 绑定最小值和最大值两个指针。设置 Min、Max 和 Step 控制范围及步长，值需要保存在视图函数外。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 拖动上方滑块，再拖动下方范围的两个端点。
2. 调整步长，用方向键查看每次变化的数值，再切换纵向。
3. 将步长设为 0.1，通过方向键修改数值，检查提示和提交计数。
4. 选择 Neutral 后开启自定义背景；再比较部件颜色和字段错误的效果。显式部件颜色优先。
5. 开启轨道内边距，确认单滑块提示仍跟随圆点；设置最小间隔并尝试让两个端点靠近。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Slider binds one `*float64`; RangeSlider binds two pointers for the lower and upper values. Min, Max and Step set the limits and increment. Keep the values outside the view function.

### Try the preview

1. Drag the upper slider, then both ends of the range below it.
2. Change the step and use arrow keys to compare increments, then try vertical layout.
3. Set the step to 0.1 and use arrow keys, checking the value tooltip and commit counts.
4. Select Neutral with a custom background, then compare part colors and field errors. Explicit part colors take priority.
5. Enable track padding and check that the single-slider tooltip follows its thumb. Set a minimum gap and try moving the range ends together.

note.zh: 本例范围为 0–100。OnChange 报告实时变化；需要在拖动结束后处理结果时，可使用 OnCommit。 禁用父容器也会取消正在进行的拖拽。Tooltip 为布尔开关，不提供完整 TooltipOptions；仅单滑块的 UI.Root.PaddingX / PaddingY 调整轨道有效区。没有可交互的三端点以上模型。
note.en: This example uses a 0–100 range. OnChange reports live changes; use OnCommit to handle a completed adjustment. Disabling a parent cancels an active drag. Tooltip is a boolean switch rather than full TooltipOptions. Only the single slider uses UI.Root.PaddingX / PaddingY to set its active track area. Models with three or more interactive thumbs are not provided.

label.zh: 自定义轨道与滑块颜色
增加单滑块轨道内边距

state: Value, Low, High float64; Changes, Commits, RangeChanges, RangeCommits int

name: Select

description.zh: 打开下拉列表，选择一个或多个值。
description.en: Choose one or more values from a dropdown list.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

单选使用 Select 并绑定一个值，多选使用 SelectMultiple 并绑定值切片。Option.Value 是稳定标识，Label 是显示名称，Description 补充说明。Open 指向持久 bool，组件和应用都可修改它；不设置时组件自行保存打开状态。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 聚焦单选后输入 r，观察值和变更次数；展开后输入 t，再按 Enter 提交。Disabled language 不可选。
2. 开启加载，切换加载位置、头像和自定义图标；加载期间仍可选择。
3. 切换高亮和 Neutral 颜色，观察自定义主题色。
4. 使用 Toggle single select / Toggle multiple select 按钮改变打开状态；按 Escape 关闭并返回触发器。多选每次增删只通知一次。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Bind one value with Select or a slice with SelectMultiple. Option.Value is the stable ID, Label is display text and Description adds detail. Open points to a persistent bool writable by both the component and application; omit it for internal state.

### Try the preview

1. Focus the single trigger and type r; inspect the value and count. Open it, type t and press Enter to commit. Disabled language cannot be chosen.
2. Enable loading, change its placement, avatar and custom icons. Selection remains available while loading.
3. Toggle Highlight and the Neutral color to inspect the custom theme.
4. Use Toggle single select / Toggle multiple select, then Escape to restore trigger focus. Each multiple-selection toggle reports one change.

note.zh: 空字符串和零值都可以是合法的 Option.Value。需要未选择状态时使用 Optional[T] 或明确的业务值。单选缺失值显示占位文字；多选暂时缺失的已选项保留名称，空标签不参与逗号拼接。外部赋值、改变外观及开关面板不触发 OnChange。关闭弹层后，焦点返回当前触发器；高亮项被删除时，列表会定位到有效选中项或第一个可用项。
note.en: Empty strings and zero values can be valid option values. Use Optional[T] or an explicit business value for absence. A missing single value shows the placeholder; multiple selections retain labels for temporarily missing items and omit empty labels from joined text. External assignments, appearance changes and opening do not call OnChange. Closing the popup restores focus to the current trigger. If the highlighted item is removed, the list moves to a valid selected item or the first available item.

state: Value string; Many []string; Open, ManyOpen bool; Changes, ManyChanges int

name: InputMenu

description.zh: 在输入框中搜索，并从候选项中选择。
description.en: Search in an input and select from its suggestions.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

SearchState.Query 保存草稿，Selected 保存单选 ID，SelectedValues 保存多选 ID。单选初始值在草稿为空时显示其名称；外部选中值在未编辑时同步显示，编辑中的草稿保留到关闭或失焦。Open 是可选的持久 bool 指针。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击默认只聚焦；输入语言或按方向键打开列表，按 Enter 选择。开启 OpenOnClick 可以恢复点击即打开。
2. 开启多选，选择两项；草稿为空时也可用清空按钮移除全部选择。ResetModelValueOnClear=false 时清空只修改草稿。
3. 启用加载和头像，切换 Loop / HighlightOnHover，观察焦点、选择与事件计数。
4. 切换 Autocomplete，输入 Go 的前缀并选择建议，再输入自由文本并提交。该模式忽略 Multiple 和选择后的重置开关。
5. 开启创建候选，输入未知名称；创建只报告请求，不替应用添加选项。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

SearchState.Query stores the draft, Selected the single ID and SelectedValues the multiple IDs. An initial single value fills an empty draft; external selection updates refresh idle display while active drafts survive until closing or blur. Open is an optional persistent bool pointer.

### Try the preview

1. Clicking only focuses by default. Type or press an arrow to open, then Enter to choose. Enable OpenOnClick for click-to-open.
2. Enable Multiple and choose two items. Clear removes all selections even with an empty draft; ResetModelValueOnClear=false retains IDs.
3. Enable loading and avatar, change Loop / HighlightOnHover and inspect focus, values and event counts.
4. Switch to Autocomplete, choose a suggestion, then submit free text. It ignores Multiple and reset-on-select.
5. Enable creation and enter an unknown name; creation reports a request without adding an item.

note.zh: Query 的 OnChange 只报告编辑，OnSelect 报告激活的选项，OnValuesChange 报告多选值变化；OnClear 报告清空按钮操作。删除标签不发送 OnSelect。默认过滤保留数据顺序，不区分大小写，未实现上游的匹配相关度排序和语言学等价匹配。选项数据变化会关闭旧面板；外部请求取消和过期结果处理由应用负责。SearchSelect 保留旧的点击打开和名称加描述过滤。
note.en: OnChange reports draft edits, OnSelect item activation, OnValuesChange multiple-value changes and OnClear the clear action. Tag deletion does not emit OnSelect. Native filtering keeps input order and ignores case; upstream relevance sorting and locale-sensitive equivalence are not implemented. Changed item data closes the old list; cancellation and stale-result handling belong to the application. SearchSelect retains legacy click-to-open and label-plus-description filtering.

label.zh: 自定义选择和删除图标

state: Search nui.SearchState; Open bool; Queries, Selections, Values, Clears, Submits int; Created string

name: Popover

description.zh: 在按钮等控件旁打开补充内容。
description.en: Open related content beside a button or other control.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

先创建锚点控件，再将它和持久打开状态传给 Popover。内容回调接收局部主题；普通文字继承最终 Panel 的字体、颜色和间距，原生控件仍使用局部主题。点击模式的开关动作由调用者绑定。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Open details，编辑 Popover draft；切换使用另一锚点，输入与选区保持。关闭后焦点回到当前锚点。
2. 开启面板样式，观察普通文字、背景和内容间距。开启再关闭减少动态效果，已有弹层不会重新入场。
3. 在全部参数中将 Mode 设为 PopoverHover，检查 OpenDelay / CloseDelay。延迟单位为毫秒。
4. 修改 Placement、Width、Offset 或 Dismissible；Explicit false 阻止 Escape 和外部点击，Close 仍可关闭。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Create an anchor and pass it with persistent open state to Popover. The content callback receives the local theme. Plain text inherits final Panel typography, color and spacing while native widgets keep that theme. Bind click-mode toggling in the caller.

### Try the preview

1. Open the panel and edit Popover draft. Change the anchor while preserving input and selection; closing returns focus to the current anchor.
2. Enable panel styling to inspect text, surface and spacing. Toggle reduced motion without replaying entry on the visible panel.
3. Set Mode to PopoverHover under All fields and check the delays, measured in milliseconds.
4. Change Placement, Width, Offset or Dismissible. Explicit false blocks Escape and outside dismissal; Close still works.

note.zh: 示例明确设置 240 DIP 宽度。组件未设置 Width 时按内容布局；MaxHeight 默认 320 DIP，不自动加入滚动。MatchAnchor 设定最小宽度，Label 仅是辅助技术名称。实际窗口边界由 MyGo 处理，边缘留白为 4 DIP；上游 collisionPadding 默认 8 px。没有 modal、arrow、portal 和虚拟锚点参数。失焦到外部按钮时保留该目标的焦点，内容内关闭才返回当前锚点。
note.en: The example explicitly uses 240 DIP width. Unset Width follows content; default MaxHeight is 320 DIP without automatic scrolling. MatchAnchor sets a minimum width and Label is an accessible name. MyGo handles collisions with a 4 DIP window margin, versus upstream collisionPadding 8 px. Modal, arrow, portal and virtual anchors are not exposed. An outside button keeps its focus; closing from within returns to the current anchor.

label.zh: 允许 Escape 或外部点击关闭
label.en: Dismiss with Escape or outside click

name: ScrollArea

description.zh: 让超出显示区域的内容可以滚动。
description.en: Scroll content that exceeds the visible area.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

给返回的外层元素设置 Height、Fill 或 Grow，确定滚动视口。Direction 选择纵向、横向或双向；State 指向每个实例独立的 ui.ScrollState，X / Y 为当前位置，MaxX / MaxY 为本次布局的边界。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 切换 Direction，使用滚轮或拖动滚动条，查看两轴位置。横向内容排成一行，双向显示宽行。
2. 设置滚动条颜色或宽度，再切换圆角；已有可用轴的偏移保持，内容按 Root 圆角裁剪。
3. 点击 Scroll to end / Scroll to start，观察持久状态更新。
4. 清空颜色设置恢复 BorderAccented；宽度 0 仍使用 MyGo 默认 6 DIP。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Set Height, Fill or Grow on the returned wrapper to define the viewport. Direction selects vertical, horizontal or both axes. Give each instance its own ui.ScrollState: X / Y are offsets and MaxX / MaxY are the laid-out bounds.

### Try the preview

1. Change Direction and use the wheel or drag a scrollbar while inspecting offsets. Horizontal items form a row; both-axis mode shows wide rows.
2. Change thumb color, width and rounding. Available-axis offsets remain and content clips to Root corners.
3. Use Scroll to end / Scroll to start to update persistent state.
4. Clear the color to restore BorderAccented. Width 0 retains MyGo’s 6 DIP default.

note.zh: 所有内容都会构建，不提供 Nuxt ScrollArea 的 items / virtualize、边缘渐变阴影或无限加载。大量数据使用 Listbox / Table 的虚拟列表。上游 scroll 事件来自虚拟器；ui.ScrollState.Scrolling() 只报告程序化平滑滚动，两者不能等同。透明颜色只隐藏滚动条绘制，命中区域仍存在。
note.en: All content is built. Nuxt ScrollArea items / virtualization, fading edge shadows and infinite loading are not exposed; use Listbox or Table for virtual lists. Upstream scroll events come from the virtualizer; ui.ScrollState.Scrolling() only reports programmatic smooth scrolling. A transparent thumb retains its hit area.

name: Tooltip

description.zh: 悬停或键盘聚焦时显示简短说明。
description.en: Show a short explanation on hover or keyboard focus.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

把本次构建中的控件作为 anchor 传给 Tooltip，再设置文字和 Kbds。Open 绑定持久布尔值；DelayDuration 使用 Optional[time.Duration]，显式 0 表示立即显示。提示文字和格式化后的快捷键会追加到锚点 Description。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 悬停按钮，或按 Tab 聚焦；焦点触发立即显示。
2. 打开指定悬停延迟，比较 0 和 1000 毫秒；离开按钮取消等待。
3. 点击 Toggle tooltip 后按 Escape，或点击其他控件，检查打开状态。
4. 调整最大宽度和间距，把提示文字清空以查看仅快捷键的布局。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass an anchor from the current build, text and optional Kbds. Bind Open to persistent state. DelayDuration is an Optional[time.Duration]; explicit zero shows immediately. Text and formatted keys append to the anchor description.

### Try the preview

1. Hover the button or use Tab; keyboard focus opens immediately.
2. Enable Custom hover delay and compare 0 with 1000 ms. Leaving cancels the pending delay.
3. Use Toggle tooltip, then Escape or an outside press, and check the state.
4. Change width and spacing, or clear the text for a keys-only tooltip.

note.zh: 未指定延迟时保留 MyGo 的 600ms 默认值，连续提示使用 400ms 快速切换窗口；Nuxt UI 默认分别为 700ms 和 300ms。Go 提示不接收指针或焦点，离开锚点就关闭，不提供上游的可悬停内容和任意内容插槽。多行或交互内容使用 Popover。Kbds 在所有窗口宽度下显示。
note.en: Unset delay preserves MyGo’s 600ms default and a 400ms warm-switch window; Nuxt UI defaults are 700ms and 300ms. Go tips do not receive pointer input or focus and close when the pointer leaves the anchor. Hoverable content and arbitrary content slots are unavailable; use Popover for multiline or interactive content. Kbds remain visible at every window width.

label.zh: 增大文字与快捷键间距

name: Modal

description.zh: 在对话框中完成编辑或确认操作。
description.en: Complete an edit or confirmation in a modal dialog.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用持久 bool 保存打开状态，每次构建都调用 ModalWithOptions，包括关闭时。Title / Description 设置名称与说明，内容回调构建可滚动正文，Footer 构建底部操作。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 打开并编辑 Project name，点击 Save，再打开确认草稿保留。
2. 切换 Overlay、Transition 和 Fullscreen，查看遮罩、入场和尺寸变化。
3. 把 Dismissible 设为否，按 Escape，观察 Prevented 计数；关闭按钮仍可关闭。
4. 启用自定义关闭按钮，检查尺寸和颜色；移除标题区后正文不留空白。
5. 启用较长正文，滚动时标题和 Save 留在原位置。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep a persistent open bool and call ModalWithOptions on every build, even while closed. Title and Description name the dialog, the content callback builds a scrolling body, and Footer builds actions.

### Try the preview

1. Edit Project name, Save, and reopen to check the retained draft.
2. Compare Overlay, Transition and Fullscreen.
3. Set Dismissible to No and press Escape: Prevented increases while the close button remains usable.
4. Enable the custom close button or remove the header to inspect their layout.
5. Enable a long body: the title and Save stay in place while the body scrolls.

note.zh: Overlay=false 只隐藏遮罩，焦点仍限制在对话框内。CloseButton=false 隐藏关闭按钮；Dismissible=false 只阻止 Escape 和外部点击，并通知 OnClosePrevent。OnClose 只统计组件默认关闭动作，Save 由示例直接修改状态，不触发该通知。关闭立即卸载内容，没有退出动画或保持挂载选项；应用持久草稿保留。
note.en: Overlay=false hides the backdrop while keeping modal focus containment. CloseButton=false hides the close button. Dismissible=false blocks Escape and outside clicks and calls OnClosePrevent. OnClose counts component dismissal only; Save changes application state directly. Closing unmounts immediately, with no exit animation or keep-mounted option; persistent application drafts remain.

label.zh: 允许 Escape 或外部点击关闭
label.en: Dismiss with Escape or outside click

name: Slideover

description.zh: 从窗口边缘打开详情或编辑面板。
description.en: Open a detail or editing panel from a window edge.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用持久 bool 控制 Slideover，并在关闭期间继续调用。Side 选择物理边缘，Extent 控制对应轴尺寸；Inset 增加 16 DIP 边距和 8 DIP 圆角。顶部和底部未设置 Extent 时按内容高度布局，空正文也保留默认内边距。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 打开面板、编辑 Panel draft，再切换 Side 和 Inset，检查草稿保留。
2. 比较未指定尺寸和显式尺寸；顶部或底部开启空正文，观察内容高度。
3. 开启自定义遮罩，关闭面板时检查遮罩同步淡出。
4. 关闭 Transition 后立即切换；Dismissible=false 时 Escape 只增加 Prevented 计数。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep a persistent open bool and keep calling Slideover during closing. Side selects a physical edge and Extent sizes its axis. Inset adds a 16 DIP margin and 8 DIP corners. Top and bottom panels fit content without Extent; an empty body still retains its padding.

### Try the preview

1. Edit Panel draft, then change Side and Inset to check retained input.
2. Compare automatic and explicit extents; try an empty top/bottom body.
3. Enable a custom backdrop and check its exit fade.
4. Disable Transition for immediate changes; Dismissible=false makes Escape increase only Prevented.

note.zh: Width、MaxHeight、Fullscreen 来自嵌入的 ModalOptions，不参与 Slideover 布局。退出期间仍限制焦点，并禁止面板操作，完成后才恢复焦点；没有保持挂载或非模态模式。左右默认宽 448 DIP，再受窗口可用空间限制；Go 不使用上游小屏全宽断点。
note.en: Inherited Width, MaxHeight and Fullscreen do not affect Slideover layout. Exit retains modal focus and disables panel actions until unmount and focus restoration. Keep-mounted and non-modal modes are unavailable. Side panels default to 448 DIP within available space; Go does not apply the upstream small-screen full-width breakpoint.

label.en: Dismiss with Escape or outside click

name: Toast

description.zh: 短暂显示操作结果，不要求用户立即处理。
description.en: Briefly show the result of an action.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

每个窗口创建一次 ToastViewport，在点击或任务完成后的 UI 处理中调用 Toast。返回的 ID 可交给 CloseToast；同 ID 再次发布会替换内容并重置时长。Actions 使用稳定 ID 后可在更新和重排时保留焦点。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Show notification，比较头像、关闭按钮、操作方向和进度颜色；更改这些参数后再次发布。
2. Keep 执行动作并保留通知，Done 执行后关闭。
3. 聚焦 Keep，再用鼠标点击 Update focused notification，检查方向和顺序变化后仍可操作同一按钮。
4. 位置、宽度和可见数量立即作用于视口；关闭固定 ID 更新后可发布多条。顶部位置将最新通知放在顶部，RTL 不交换物理左右。
5. 常驻通知不显示倒计时，Clear notifications 关闭当前窗口的全部通知。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build ToastViewport once per window and call Toast from actions or UI handling of completed work. CloseToast accepts the returned ID. Publishing the same ID replaces its content and restarts its timeout. Stable action IDs preserve focus across replacement and reordering.

### Try the preview

1. Publish and compare avatar, close, orientation and progress options; publish again after changing them.
2. Keep runs without closing; Done runs and closes.
3. Focus Keep, then click Update focused notification with the pointer to change order and orientation while retaining the action focus.
4. Position, width and visible count affect the live viewport. Disable fixed-ID updates to queue several notices. Top positions put the newest first, and RTL preserves physical sides.
5. Persistent notices omit the countdown. Clear notifications clears this window’s queue.

note.zh: 本例默认 4 秒，组件 Timeout=0 使用 5 秒，负值常驻；Nuxt UI 的 duration=0 则表示常驻。每条通知保存发布时的主题和配置，现有通知的关闭名称仍随语言变化。MyGo 最多提供 3 条可见通知，较早项仍计时，关闭较新项后可能重新出现；这与上游 max=5 及丢弃最旧项不同。样例和复制程序均显式使用 NuxtUI Go 的 ToastViewport。
note.en: This demo uses four seconds. Go Timeout=0 means the five-second default and negative values persist; Nuxt UI duration=0 persists. A notice snapshots its theme and configuration, while its generated close name follows locale changes. MyGo supplies at most three visible notices; older queued notices keep timing and may reappear after newer ones close. Upstream max defaults to five and drops older entries. Both preview and copied code explicitly build the NuxtUI Go viewport.

label.zh: 使用固定 ID 更新

name: DropdownMenu

description.zh: 点击按钮后，从菜单中选择操作。
description.en: Choose an action from a button’s dropdown menu.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

为每个触发器保存独立的 MenuState，项目使用稳定且唯一的 ID。把按钮作为 DropdownMenu 的锚点；点击或按上下方向键打开。MenuOptions 配置尺寸、图标、导航及筛选；子菜单通过 MenuItem.Content 单独配置。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整 Size，查看描述、头像和快捷键的尺寸及对齐。加载图标只表示状态，Edit 仍可选择；Disabled 单独控制是否可操作。
2. 选择 Pinned，菜单保留打开，检查勾选和动作计数；选择 Reverse actions 后按 Enter，确认焦点仍属于原来的动作。
3. 开启筛选，输入 copy 后按 Enter；Escape 先清空搜索，再关闭菜单。开启子菜单筛选后进入 Export，分别检查搜索和返回父项。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep an independent MenuState for each trigger and stable, unique item IDs. Pass a button as the anchor; click it or use Up/Down to open. MenuOptions controls size, icons, navigation and filtering. Configure individual submenus through MenuItem.Content.

### Try the preview

1. Change Size and inspect descriptions, avatars and keyboard badges. Loading changes the icon but leaves Edit selectable; Disabled controls interaction separately.
2. Select Pinned to retain the menu and inspect callback counts. Choose Reverse actions and press Enter to confirm focus stays with the same action.
3. Enable filtering, enter copy and press Enter. Escape clears the query before closing. Enable submenu filtering, enter Export and test searching and returning to its parent.

note.zh: 菜单使用非模态原生弹层，外部点击关闭后继续传给目标。Loop 默认 false；Shortcut 只显示按键，不注册快捷键。筛选按字段做不区分大小写的包含匹配，保留项目顺序；IgnoreFilter=true 时由应用提供结果。MenuState.Query 保存未绑定 SearchTerm 的根查询，子级各自保存查询。本例的操作只更新状态。
note.en: Menus use non-modal native overlays; outside clicks dismiss and continue to their targets. Loop defaults to false. Shortcut displays keys without registering commands. Filtering uses case-insensitive substring matching and preserves item order; IgnoreFilter leaves results to the application. MenuState.Query stores an unbound root query, with separate drafts per submenu. These actions only update example state.

name: ContextMenu

description.zh: 右键点击内容时显示相关操作。
description.en: Show actions for content on right-click.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

为每个触发器保存独立的 MenuState，项目使用稳定且唯一的 ID。在目标区域点击右键，或使用 Menu 键、Shift+F10 打开。MenuOptions 配置尺寸、图标、导航及筛选；子菜单通过 MenuItem.Content 单独配置。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整 Size，查看描述、头像和快捷键的尺寸及对齐。加载图标只表示状态，Edit 仍可选择；Disabled 单独控制是否可操作。
2. 选择 Pinned，菜单保留打开，检查勾选和动作计数；选择 Reverse actions 后按 Enter，确认焦点仍属于原来的动作。
3. 开启筛选，输入 copy 后按 Enter；Escape 先清空搜索，再关闭菜单。开启子菜单筛选后进入 Export，分别检查搜索和返回父项。
4. 在目标的不同位置连续点击右键，检查菜单重新定位；选择 Move target 时，菜单留在原点击坐标。关闭后使用 Open at target，检查按目标区域重新定位。
5. 禁用整个菜单后左键点击目标，Target clicks 仍会增加。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep an independent MenuState for each trigger and stable, unique item IDs. Right-click the target or use the Menu key or Shift+F10. MenuOptions controls size, icons, navigation and filtering. Configure individual submenus through MenuItem.Content.

### Try the preview

1. Change Size and inspect descriptions, avatars and keyboard badges. Loading changes the icon but leaves Edit selectable; Disabled controls interaction separately.
2. Select Pinned to retain the menu and inspect callback counts. Choose Reverse actions and press Enter to confirm focus stays with the same action.
3. Enable filtering, enter copy and press Enter. Escape clears the query before closing. Enable submenu filtering, enter Export and test searching and returning to its parent.
4. Right-click different points of the target to reposition the open menu. Move target keeps the menu at the original pointer coordinates. After closing, Open at target anchors a new menu to the target.
5. Disable the menu and left-click the target; Target clicks still increases.

note.zh: 菜单使用非模态原生弹层，外部点击关闭后继续传给目标。Loop 默认 false；Shortcut 只显示按键，不注册快捷键。筛选按字段做不区分大小写的包含匹配，保留项目顺序；IgnoreFilter=true 时由应用提供结果。MenuState.Query 保存未绑定 SearchTerm 的根查询，子级各自保存查询。本例的操作只更新状态。 筛选框和 Radio 为原生扩展；Nuxt ContextMenu 没有内置筛选框。 根菜单默认向右打开，间隔 2 DIP；Placement 和 Offset 为可选原生扩展。右键坐标保存在窗口内，目标布局移动不会改变该位置。

Filtering uses case-insensitive substring matching and preserves item order; IgnoreFilter leaves results to the application. MenuState.Query stores an unbound root query, with separate drafts per submenu. These actions only update example state. Filtering and Radio items are native extensions; Nuxt ContextMenu has no built-in filter input. Root placement defaults to the right with a 2 DIP gap; Placement and Offset are optional native extensions. Pointer coordinates stay fixed in the window when the target moves.

name: Tabs

description.zh: 在一组相关内容面板之间切换。
description.en: Switch between related content panels.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

TabItem 的稳定 ID 同时用于选择和控件身份；通过 Content 构建面板，Avatar、Badge、BadgeOptions 和 UI 配置标签内容及外观。TabsOptions.Content=false 不构建面板，KeepMounted 则控制未激活面板是否保留局部状态。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 打开头像、徽标和指示器配置，调整大小及下划线样式；徽标文字 0 会正常显示，Icon 优先于 Avatar。
2. 自动模式用对应方向键直接切换；手动模式只移动焦点，按 Enter 或 Space 激活。
3. 编辑 Tab draft，开启 KeepMounted，切换面板后使用撤销。使用 Reverse tabs 检查稳定 ID；在数据编辑器移除当前项，或切换 Overview 禁用，观察回退选择不增加 Changes。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Stable TabItem IDs identify both selection and widget state. Build panels with Content, and configure labels using Avatar, Badge, BadgeOptions and UI. TabsOptions.Content=false omits panels; KeepMounted controls local state in inactive panels.

### Try the preview

1. Enable avatars, badges and indicator styling, then change size or underline style. Badge text 0 is displayed, and Icon takes priority over Avatar.
2. Automatic mode activates with the orientation’s arrow keys. Manual mode moves focus; use Enter or Space to activate.
3. Edit Tab draft and enable KeepMounted to retain undo across switches. Reverse tabs to check stable identity. Remove the active item in the data editor or toggle Overview disabled; fallback selection does not increase Changes.

note.zh: 空值、缺失或禁用的选中 ID 会回退到首个可用项，不通知 OnChange；全部禁用时保留业务 ID。Content=false 会卸载所有面板，即使 KeepMounted=true。徽标默认 SM / Neutral / Outline，实际高度取决于字体。面板使用可聚焦的原生 group；没有完整的 Web tabpanel 关系或跨项滑动指示器动画。
note.en: Empty, missing or disabled selection falls back to the first enabled item without OnChange. An all-disabled list preserves the business ID. Content=false unmounts all panels even with KeepMounted=true. Badges default to SM / Neutral / Outline, with height depending on font metrics. Panels are focusable native groups; full Web tabpanel relationships and sliding indicator animation are not provided.

name: Collapsible

description.zh: 按需展开或收起一个内容区域。
description.en: Expand or collapse a single section.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用持久 `*bool` 保存展开状态，在内容回调中构建正文。Disabled 只禁用标题，已展开的正文仍可操作。KeepMounted 保留隐藏控件的选区、撤销历史和局部状态，应用草稿始终由调用者保存。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 编辑草稿，切换 KeepMounted，再关闭和打开正文。
2. 禁用标题后点击正文操作，确认正文仍可使用。
3. 切换尾部图标和减少动态效果，或使用按钮直接修改打开状态。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep the open state in a persistent `*bool` and build the body in its callback. Disabled affects the heading; an open body remains interactive. KeepMounted preserves hidden controls, including selections and undo history. The caller always owns application drafts.

### Try the preview

1. Edit the draft, change KeepMounted, then close and reopen the body.
2. Disable the heading and activate the body action.
3. Change the trailing icon or reduced-motion setting, or assign the open state using the button.

note.zh: Nuxt Collapsible 的触发器由插槽提供；Go 的 Label、Icon、TrailingIcon 和默认外观是原生扩展。KeepMounted 隐藏时仍构建正文；关闭中的正文立即停止接收输入。直接修改状态不触发 OnChange。
note.en: Nuxt Collapsible receives its trigger through a slot. Go’s Label, Icon, TrailingIcon and built-in trigger appearance are native extensions. KeepMounted continues building hidden content; closing content immediately stops accepting input. External assignments do not emit OnChange.

Open bool

name: Accordion

description.zh: 用多个可折叠区域组织内容。
description.en: Organize content into several collapsible sections.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

每项使用稳定且唯一的 ID，展开状态保存在 `*[]string`。Multiple 默认 false；Collapsible 默认 true，单开模式设为 false 后不能关闭当前项，但仍可切到其他项。Disabled 只禁用标题，正文控件继续使用自身的禁用设置。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 编辑 Installation 中的草稿，再打开 Usage，比较单开和多开模式。
2. 开启 KeepMounted，关闭重开或反转项目顺序，检查草稿和编辑状态。
3. 比较全局与单项尾部图标、单项 UI，以及禁用标题后的正文操作。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use stable, unique item IDs and store open IDs in a `*[]string`. Multiple defaults to false. Collapsible defaults to true; setting it to false in single mode prevents closing the current item but still permits selecting another. Disabled affects headings; body controls keep their own disabled settings.

### Try the preview

1. Edit the Installation draft, then open Usage to compare single and multiple modes.
2. Enable KeepMounted, close and reopen sections or reverse their order, and check the draft and editor state.
3. Compare shared and per-item trailing icons, item UI, and body actions while headings are disabled.

note.zh: 上下方向键、Home 和 End 在可用标题间移动。单项 TrailingIcon 优先于组件设置；UI 覆盖本项部件。KeepMounted 隐藏时仍执行正文回调；关闭中的正文不可操作，减少动态效果时立即切换。
note.en: Up/Down, Home and End move between enabled headings. An item’s TrailingIcon overrides the component setting, and UI styles only that item. KeepMounted still calls hidden content builders. Closing bodies are inert, and reduced motion switches immediately.

name: Breadcrumb

description.zh: 显示当前页面在导航层级中的位置。
description.en: Show the current page within a navigation hierarchy.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

每个路径项使用稳定 ID。OnSelect 由应用执行导航；未提供回调的项目只展示文字，末项有回调时也可以操作。Active 未设置时仅末项高亮，显式 false 可以关闭高亮。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 将显示上限设为 2 或 3，检查省略项两侧的分隔图标。
2. 比较默认和自定义分隔符、头像与图标优先级。
3. 点击末项，再禁用它，观察点击计数。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Give each item a stable ID and use OnSelect for application navigation. Items without callbacks are display-only; the final item is actionable when a callback is supplied. Active defaults to the final item, while explicit false removes its active style.

### Try the preview

1. Set Maximum to 2 or 3 and inspect the separators around the ellipsis.
2. Compare custom separators and avatar/icon priority.
3. Activate the final item, then disable it and check the click count.

note.zh: MaxItems 是原生扩展：小于 2 不截断，达到 2 时保留首项和末尾项目，省略号不可操作。Color 默认 Primary，Neutral 的活动文字使用 Highlighted。路由匹配、URL 打开及历史记录由应用负责。
note.en: MaxItems is a native extension. Values below 2 do not truncate; larger values retain the first and trailing items with a non-interactive ellipsis. Color defaults to Primary; Neutral uses Highlighted for active text. Routing, URL opening and history remain application-owned.

name: Pagination

description.zh: 切换数据页，并显示当前页码。
description.en: Change data pages and show the current page number.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 `*int` 保存从 1 开始的页码。PageSize 默认 10，Total 是总条数；SiblingCount 可显式设置为 0。OnChange 只报告用户切换，修改总数导致的页码修正不通知。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 切换首末页、相邻页和首尾页按钮。
2. 减少总条数，检查页码限制和通知计数。
3. 自定义各控制图标及活动按钮外观；自定义图标在 RTL 下保持原样。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Store the one-based page in a `*int`. PageSize defaults to 10 and Total is the item count. SiblingCount supports explicit zero. OnChange reports user selection only; clamping after a total change is silent.

### Try the preview

1. Compare first/last controls, siblings and edge numbers.
2. Reduce Total and inspect clamping and the notification count.
3. Customize control icons and active styling. Custom icons are kept as supplied in RTL.

note.zh: PageSize≤0 按 10 处理，Total≤0 仍保留第 1 页；相邻页数限制为 0–10。省略号不可交互。Root/List 共用布局元素，Item 样式保留对所有按钮的兼容覆盖；First、Previous、Next、Last 可进一步区分控制按钮。
note.en: PageSize≤0 uses 10, and Total≤0 retains page 1. Siblings are bounded to 0–10. Ellipses are inert. Root/List share a layout element; Item continues styling every button for compatibility, with First, Previous, Next and Last providing more specific control styles.

name: Stepper

description.zh: 展示流程步骤，并控制当前步骤。
description.en: Display a process and select its current step.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用稳定 ID 保存当前步骤，Linear 默认 true，允许返回或进入紧邻的下一步。方向键只移动焦点，Enter/Space 激活。StepItem.Content 构建当前步骤正文，UI 配置单项部件。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 编辑 Details 的草稿，再切到 Team，比较横向与纵向布局。
2. 反转顺序，检查当前 ID 和草稿仍保留。
3. 开启拒绝 Review 选择，比较用户激活和直接赋值；CanSelect 只约束用户操作。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Store the current stable step ID. Linear defaults to true, allowing previous steps or the immediately following step. Arrows move focus; Enter/Space activates. StepItem.Content builds the active body, and UI styles individual items.

### Try the preview

1. Edit the Details draft, switch to Team and compare orientations.
2. Reverse the items and inspect the retained ID and draft.
3. Reject Review selection and compare user activation with external assignment; CanSelect only guards user actions.

note.zh: 切换步骤会卸载旧正文，业务草稿由应用持有；同一当前 ID 的重排或方向切换保留正文身份。未知 ID 表示尚未开始，不自动选择首项。没有 Nuxt 的 next/prev 暴露方法，应用可更新绑定 ID。
note.en: Changing steps unmounts the previous body; application drafts remain caller-owned. Reordering or changing orientation with the same active ID preserves body identity. Unknown IDs mean not started and do not select the first item automatically. There are no Nuxt-style exposed next/prev methods; update the bound ID from the application.
