name: Timeline

description.zh: 按顺序展示活动记录或里程碑。
description.en: Display activities or milestones in sequence.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Timeline 默认纵向。Current 是从 0 开始的可选索引，非空 CurrentID 优先。Reverse 反转进度解释，不调整项目顺序。Time 使用应用格式化后的字符串，DateSlot 可独立配置日期文字。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 比较方向、尺寸、头像和日期样式。
2. 使用 CurrentID 指定 build，再切换 Reverse，检查两侧连接线。
3. 点击或用 Tab、Enter/Space 选择项目，按需开启点击后更新当前项。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Timeline is vertical by default. Current is an optional zero-based index, overridden by a non-empty CurrentID. Reverse changes progress interpretation without reordering items. Time is an application-formatted string, styled independently through DateSlot.

### Try the preview

1. Compare orientations, sizes, avatars and date styles.
2. Set CurrentID to build and toggle Reverse to inspect both connectors.
3. Select by clicking or Tab and Enter/Space; optionally follow the selection in the application.

note.zh: OnSelect 不自动改变进度。CurrentID 无匹配时不回退 Current；无效索引不高亮任何项。Color 单项覆盖和 Content 是原生扩展；当前只提供 XS–XL 五档尺寸。
note.en: OnSelect does not change progress automatically. An unmatched CurrentID does not fall back to Current, and invalid indexes highlight no items. Per-item Color and Content are native extensions; sizes are limited to XS–XL.

name: Banner

description.zh: 在页面内持续显示可关闭的消息。
description.en: Display a persistent, dismissible message within a page.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Banner 使用应用保存的 `*bool` 控制显示。默认有状态绑定时显示关闭按钮；CloseButton 可显式关闭，Close 和 CloseIcon 可配置按钮。OnSelect 处理整条通知的操作，内部操作按钮独立执行。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 分别激活通知和 Release notes，比较两个计数。
2. 自定义关闭按钮，关闭后重新显示。
3. 改变标题长度和窗口宽度，检查单行截断和响应式对齐。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Control visibility with an application-owned `*bool`. A bound state shows the close button by default; CloseButton can hide it, while Close and CloseIcon customize it. OnSelect handles banner activation independently from inner actions.

### Try the preview

1. Activate the banner and Release notes separately and compare the counters.
2. Customize the close button, dismiss the banner and show it again.
3. Change title length and window width to inspect truncation and responsive alignment.

note.zh: 正文保持单行；窗口宽度达到 1024 DIP 后居中，较窄时从起始边排列。nil 状态默认无关闭按钮，显式启用后使用组件内状态，卸载后重置。跨启动持久化和导航由应用负责，未使用 localStorage。
note.en: Content remains on one line. It is centered from a 1024 DIP window width and start-aligned below that breakpoint. A nil state has no close button by default; explicitly enabling it uses local state that resets on unmount. Cross-launch persistence and navigation are application-owned, without localStorage.

name: Error

description.zh: 显示失败原因，并提供重试操作。
description.en: Explain a failure and provide a retry action.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

ErrorView 展示 Status、Title 和 Description。只有传入 OnRetry 才有默认操作；Clear=false 隐藏默认操作，Retry 配置按钮，Actions 可以替换整个操作区。组件不清除 Nuxt 错误状态或自动跳转。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 清空标题或让说明等于标题，检查空白和重复文字是否消失。
2. 比较默认按钮、自定义按钮和替代操作区。
3. 改变窗口宽度：标题在 640 DIP 以下使用 36 DIP 字号，较宽时为 48 DIP。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

ErrorView presents Status, Title and Description. The default action requires OnRetry. Clear=false hides it, Retry configures its button, and Actions replaces the action area. The component does not clear Nuxt error state or redirect automatically.

### Try the preview

1. Clear the title or make the description equal to it and inspect empty or duplicate content.
2. Compare default, customized and replacement actions.
3. Resize the window: the title uses 36 DIP below 640 DIP and 48 DIP above it.

note.zh: 图标为 40 DIP；状态码、标题、说明和操作区可分别配置。保留原生嵌入布局的内边距、480 DIP 说明宽度上限及二级标题语义，不强制占满整个窗口。应用负责错误清理、重试和导航。
note.en: The icon is 40 DIP. Status, title, description and actions have separate style parts. Native embedding retains padding, a 480 DIP description limit and level-two heading semantics, without forcing full-window height. Error cleanup, retrying and navigation belong to the application.

controls.default: This example does not make network requests.

name: Form

description.zh: 校验多个字段，并在通过后处理提交。
description.en: Validate fields and handle a successful submission.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

在应用中保存 FormState，通过 FormField.Name / Value 注册字段。Validate 返回按字段名组织的错误；空名称可用于全局错误。校验通过后调用 OnSubmit，失败时调用一次 OnError。提交按钮调用 form.Submit。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 留空项目名称，点击 Save project，查看错误和焦点；输入名称后再次保存。
2. 开启模拟异步提交，再保存。默认输入和表单内按钮禁用；外部 Repeat submit 不会重复发起请求。点击 Complete request 或 Cancel request 结束。
3. 关闭提交中禁用，提交后编辑名称，再点击 Complete request；旧结果会被拒绝。
4. 开启返回全局错误，确认保存被阻止且显示错误。Restore project name 同时恢复模型并重置 Dirty。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep a FormState and register fields through FormField.Name / Value. Validate returns errors keyed by field name; an empty name represents a form-wide error. Valid submissions call OnSubmit; invalid submissions call OnError once. Submit buttons call form.Submit.

### Try the preview

1. Leave the name empty and press Save project to inspect validation and focus. Enter a name and save again.
2. Enable simulated async submission and save. Inputs and buttons inside the form are disabled by default; the external Repeat submit does not start another request. Complete or cancel the request.
3. Disable automatic loading, submit, edit the name, and complete: the stale result is rejected.
4. Enable the form-wide error to block saving. Restore project name updates the model and resets Dirty together.

note.zh: 示例通过显式按钮模拟完成，不执行网络请求。异步结果在 UI 线程通过 CompleteAsync 接收；值、草稿、字段可见性或禁用状态改变后拒绝旧结果。卸载及关窗前调用 Cancel，并由应用取消实际 I/O。业务校验仅由提交或显式 Validate 触发；Required 标记不自行校验，嵌套 Form 不自动合并校验。
note.en: Explicit buttons simulate completion without network requests. Deliver CompleteAsync on the UI thread. Value, draft, visibility or disabled-state changes reject stale results. Call Cancel before unmounting or closing and cancel actual I/O in the application. Business validation runs on submit or explicit Validate; Required does not validate by itself, and nested forms do not merge validation automatically.

name: InputNumber

description.zh: 输入数字，或使用按钮按步长增减。
description.en: Enter a number or adjust it by a fixed increment.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 Optional[float64] 区分空值与零，NumberState 保存未完成草稿。示例显式设置范围 0–100；库默认没有上下界。有效输入实时更新模型，Enter 进行步长对齐或恢复最后有效值。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 留空后点击增减按钮，先得到 StartingValue；再点击才按 Step 改变。输入 18.98、Step=1，按上方向键得到 19。
2. 按 PageUp / PageDown 改变十步，Home / End 到达边界；长按按钮连续增减。
3. 隐藏或禁用单个按钮，更换图标和方向；只有默认图标跟随方向变化。
4. 输入框聚焦后滚动鼠标，切换禁用及反转设置。关闭 FocusOnChange 后，按钮可保留自己的键盘焦点。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Optional[float64] distinguishes empty from zero; NumberState retains incomplete text. This example explicitly bounds values to 0–100; the library has no default bounds. Valid edits update immediately, while Enter snaps or restores the last valid value.

### Try the preview

1. Step from empty to StartingValue, then step again. With Step=1, type 18.98 and press Up to reach 19.
2. PageUp / PageDown move ten steps; Home / End reach bounds. Hold a button to repeat.
3. Hide or disable individual controls and change icons or orientation; only default icons follow orientation.
4. Scroll while the editor is focused and try wheel disabling or inversion. FocusOnChange=false allows a control to keep keyboard focus.

note.zh: StepSnapping 和 FocusOnChange 默认 true，滚轮默认开启。AllowInvalid 只允许有限数值超出上下界，不接受 NaN、Inf 或非法文字；启用后业务校验由应用处理。使用 ASCII 十进制及科学记数法，不支持地区、货币或 Intl 格式选项。原生失焦保留草稿，增减按钮保留 Tab 停靠点，与 Web 提交时机和焦点结构有差异。
note.en: StepSnapping and FocusOnChange default to true; wheel changes are enabled. AllowInvalid permits finite out-of-range numbers, not NaN, Infinity or invalid text; validate business rules in the application. Input uses ASCII decimal or scientific notation without locale, currency or Intl formatting. Native blur retains drafts and controls remain Tab stops, differing from the web commit timing and focus structure.

name: InputTags

description.zh: 把输入的文字添加为标签，并支持移除。
description.en: Turn typed text into removable tags.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

绑定字符串切片，TagsState.Query 保存草稿。标签与编辑器在同一行内自动换行。ConvertValue 转换新增值，DisplayValue 只改变标签文字；显示变化不会改变标签身份。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入标签并按 Enter；默认逗号也会触发添加。开启粘贴添加后可批量加入多个标签。
2. 草稿光标在开头时，按 Backspace 先选中最后一个标签，再按一次删除；左右方向键移动选择，已选中时 Home / End 到首尾。
3. 开启 AddOnTab 或 AddOnBlur，观察添加时机；Tab 添加后保留输入焦点。
4. 切换大小写显示、自定义删除图标和重复策略，观察变更、增删及拒绝计数。只读时所有修改入口均停止。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Bind a string slice and keep the draft in TagsState.Query. Tags and the editor wrap together. ConvertValue transforms new values; DisplayValue changes labels without replacing their identity.

### Try the preview

1. Type a tag and press Enter; comma also adds by default. Enable paste addition for multiple values.
2. At the start of the draft, Backspace selects the last tag before deleting it on the next press. Arrows move selection; Home / End reach the edges while a tag is selected.
3. Try AddOnTab or AddOnBlur; Tab addition retains editor focus.
4. Change label casing, delete icons and duplicate policy, then inspect change/add/remove/rejection counts. Read-only stops every mutation path.

note.zh: 字符串按大小写区分去重，转换在去重前执行。MaxTags≤0 不限数量；MaxLength 按 UTF-16 单元限制草稿，0 不限。批量粘贴成功时只通知一次 OnTagsChange，每个新增或拒绝的非空候选分别通知对应事件。粘贴保留原有草稿；重复或超限不会作为普通文本再次插入。组件使用字符串值，不提供对象模型或正则分隔符。
note.en: Deduplication is case-sensitive after conversion. MaxTags<=0 is unlimited; MaxLength limits draft UTF-16 units, with 0 unlimited. A successful paste batch emits OnTagsChange once and reports each added or rejected non-empty candidate separately. Paste preserves the existing draft; rejected candidates are not inserted as ordinary text. Values are strings, without object models or regex delimiters.

name: PinInput

description.zh: 按格输入验证码或固定长度的短文本。
description.en: Enter a verification code or other fixed-length text.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

PinInput 绑定字符串并使用一个真实编辑器，Tab 只进入一次。默认五格文本，Numeric 仅保留 ASCII 数字；完成回调只在用户修改后的长度达到要求时调用。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入或粘贴验证码，点击某一格替换；方向键、选区、删除和撤销由真实编辑器处理。
2. 改变长度或 Numeric，观察外部配置的静默规范化；它不会伪装成用户输入事件。
3. 开启 Highlight、设置分组数量并自定义分隔符，检查字号、间距和整体宽度。
4. 开启 Mask 或只读，查看显示和可操作状态；下方只显示计数，不回显被遮罩的内容。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

PinInput binds a string and uses one real editor, with a single Tab stop. It defaults to five text cells; Numeric retains ASCII digits only. Completion fires when a user change reaches the required length.

### Try the preview

1. Type or paste a code and click a cell to replace it. The real editor handles arrows, selection, deletion and undo.
2. Change length or Numeric to inspect silent external normalization; this does not emit user-input events.
3. Enable Highlight, configure separator intervals and customize parts to inspect font, gap and total width.
4. Try Mask and read-only; the summary shows counts without echoing masked content.

note.zh: 长度范围为 1–32，默认 5；字符按 rune 计数。Separator 与 SeparatorEvery 合并并去重。Root 的 Gap / Padding 和 SeparatorSlot 的字体、字号、内边距参与整体尺寸计算；原始 Style 回调改变几何时由应用协调布局。原生没有短信读取、浏览器 OTP 自动填充或每格独立输入节点；焦点由 PinState.Handle 管理。
note.en: Length is 1–32, default 5, counted in runes. Separator and SeparatorEvery combine without duplicate positions. Root gap/padding and SeparatorSlot font, size and padding contribute to total geometry; coordinate raw Style geometry overrides in the application. Native code does not read SMS, provide browser OTP autofill or create one input node per cell; use PinState.Handle for focus.

name: InputRating

description.zh: 用整数星级选择评分。
description.en: Choose a whole-number star rating.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

InputRating 绑定整数，0 表示未评分。Max 默认 5，接受 1–20；外部值和上限变化会静默限制评分。Clearable、Hoverable 默认 false。

### 交互与展示

方向键按排列方向和 RTL 移动，Home / PageUp 到 1，End / PageDown 到 Max；Space 可选中第一项或清空当前评分。悬停预览不修改值，也不增加变更计数。只读保留 Tab 焦点，使用正常颜色和默认光标。

切换两种图标和图层颜色，查看 Root、Item、Indicator、IconSlot、EmptyIconSlot 的效果。底层空图标仍在，评分层在其上叠加；IconSlot 可覆盖从 Indicator 继承的颜色。Neutral 的图标使用 Highlighted，焦点外圈使用 InvertedBackground。

减少动态效果时保留悬停缩放，只取消过渡；恢复动画不会回退到旧尺寸。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

InputRating binds an integer; 0 means unrated. Max defaults to 5 and accepts 1–20. External values and maximum changes clamp silently. Clearable and Hoverable default to false.

### Interaction and appearance

Arrow keys follow orientation and RTL. Home / PageUp selects 1, End / PageDown selects Max, and Space can select the first item or clear the current value. Hover preview does not change the value or increment the change count. Read-only ratings retain Tab focus, normal colors and the default cursor.

Toggle the two icons and layer colors to inspect Root, Item, Indicator, IconSlot and EmptyIconSlot. The empty icon remains behind the filled overlay; IconSlot can override the foreground inherited from Indicator. Neutral uses Highlighted for filled icons and InvertedBackground for its focus ring.

Reduced motion keeps hover scaling without a transition. Restoring animation does not revert the scale.

note.zh: 整数绑定没有半星等 step 参数，也没有任意 item 内容构建器。原生组件使用单焦点 slider，网页使用 radio 组；只读焦点和清空后 Space 的行为有差异。应用负责校验、保存和提交评分。
note.en: The integer binding has no fractional step or arbitrary item builder. Native ratings use one slider focus target while the web version uses a radio group; read-only focus and Space after clearing differ. Applications own validation, persistence and submission.

name: Listbox

description.zh: 在直接显示的列表中选择一项或多项。
description.en: Select one or more items from a visible list.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 `[]string` 保存选中 ID，ListboxState 保存查询、高亮和滚动状态。每项需要稳定且唯一的 ID，标签和分隔线也需要 ID。Filter 打开筛选框，FilterInput 配置输入框，Loading 显示加载图标并暂停选项操作。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 选择 Go，再次点击可取消；开启多选后用方向键移动高亮，观察选择值保持不变。
2. 搜索 cafe，查看 Café、Cafeteria、A café 的排序。先按 Enter，确认保护开关阻止选择；关闭保护后再次选择。
3. 切换尺寸、颜色和加载状态，检查头像、圆点、选中图标及回调计数。点击 Reorder options，检查高亮和选中值仍跟随 ID。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep selected IDs in `[]string` and query, highlight and scrolling in ListboxState. Every item, including labels and separators, needs a stable unique ID. Filter shows the search field; FilterInput configures it. Loading displays a spinner and suspends option actions.

### Try the preview

1. Select Go twice to toggle it off. Enable multiple selection and move the highlight with arrows without changing selection.
2. Search for cafe and compare Café, Cafeteria and A café. Press Enter while protection is enabled, then turn it off and select again.
3. Change size, color and loading; inspect avatars, chips, selection icons and callback counts. Reorder options and verify selection and highlight follow IDs.

note.zh: 筛选默认仅匹配 Label，忽略大小写和组合附加符号，按完全匹配、前缀、包含排序；不提供完整的地区排序规则。单项 Options.OnSelect 可调用 PreventDefault 取消选择。隐藏筛选框后仍使用保留的查询词；IgnoreFilter 跳过本地筛选。
note.en: Filtering defaults to Label, folds case and combining marks, and ranks exact, prefix and substring matches. It does not implement full locale collation. Item Options.OnSelect can call PreventDefault. Hiding the filter keeps the query active; IgnoreFilter bypasses local filtering.

name: SelectMenu

description.zh: 在弹出的列表中搜索并选择项目。
description.en: Search and choose items in a popup list.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

SelectMenu 组合触发器、搜索框与 Listbox。选中值为 ID 列表，SelectMenuState 保存打开状态、查询和持久焦点 Handle。FilterInput 配置搜索框；FocusSearch 控制打开后聚焦搜索框还是列表。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 打开菜单并搜索 cafe，直接按 Enter。保护开关开启时 Café 取消选择；关闭保护后重试，查看选择与开关通知次数。
2. 选择 Go，点击尾部清空按钮；关闭清空时重置选中值后，比较查询词与选中值的变化。关闭搜索框不会取消已有查询的筛选。
3. 开启模拟远程搜索，在 Remote options 中依次输入两个不同查询。点击 Complete stale request，确认旧结果被拒绝；再完成当前请求或取消请求。示例没有网络请求，所有结果都由按钮显式提交。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

SelectMenu combines a trigger, search input and Listbox. Selected values are IDs; SelectMenuState stores open state, query and persistent focus handles. FilterInput configures the search field, and FocusSearch chooses its initial focus.

### Try the preview

1. Search for cafe and press Enter directly. Café cancels selection while protection is enabled. Disable protection and compare selection and open-change counts.
2. Select Go and use the trailing clear button. Disable selection reset on clear to compare model and query changes. Hiding search does not bypass a retained query.
3. Show simulated remote search and enter two different queries in Remote options. Complete the stale request to see it rejected, then complete or cancel the current request. Buttons submit results explicitly; no network request is made.

note.zh: 默认在选择或关闭后清空查询。清空按钮始终清除查询，ResetModelValueOnClear 只控制选中值。Loading 显示触发器加载图标和原生状态行，仍允许选择已有结果。ExternalFilter 或 IgnoreFilter 跳过本地筛选；QueryState 拒绝过期结果，实际后台结果须通过 Window.Update 提交。
note.en: Selection and dismissal reset the query by default. Clear always clears the query; ResetModelValueOnClear only controls selection. Loading shows a trigger spinner and native status row while existing choices remain usable. ExternalFilter or IgnoreFilter bypasses local filtering. QueryState rejects stale results; publish real background results through Window.Update.

name: Calendar

description.zh: 在日历中选择单日或起止日期。
description.en: Choose a date or a date range from a calendar.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Calendar 绑定 DateSelection，CalendarState 保存首个显示月份、当前日期、导航视图和持久焦点。默认允许再次选择同一天来取消；PreventDeselect 可以关闭这一行为。ReadOnly 保留浏览与焦点操作，不修改日期。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 再次点击默认选中的 2024 年 2 月 15 日，观察只通知一次；开启阻止再次点击取消后重试。
2. 点击标题进入月视图，再点击年份进入年视图。选择月份只切换浏览位置，选择一天才提交日期。
3. 开启范围选择，在 20 日两侧选起止日期；比较允许经过不可用日期和七天范围限制。
4. 显示两个月，切换按显示月数翻页、固定六周、周序号及外观。窄容器中各月会换行。
5. 使用 Reset example date 或 Clear example date 修改应用模型，确认组件不发出用户改值通知。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Calendar binds DateSelection. CalendarState keeps the first displayed month, active date, navigation view and persistent focus. Selecting a date again clears it by default; PreventDeselect disables this. ReadOnly retains browsing and focus without changing the value.

### Try the preview

1. Select the initial February 15, 2024 again and check the single notification. Enable prevention and repeat.
2. Use the heading to open month and year views. Choosing a period navigates; choosing a day commits a date.
3. Select a range across the 20th, then compare allowing unavailable interior dates and a seven-day limit.
4. Display two months and change paged navigation, fixed weeks, week numbers and appearance. Months wrap in narrow containers.
5. Reset or clear the application model and verify that component change notifications are not emitted.

note.zh: 本例将今天和初值固定为 2024 年 2 月 15 日，周一为一周起点；这些是示例设置。组件的 WeekStart 兼容原有默认周日，周序号按显式 WeekStart 计算。不可用日期可浏览但不能作为端点；AllowNonContiguousRanges 只允许范围经过不可用日期，仍不能跨越禁用日期。月、年视图用于导航，值模型始终是公历日期或日期范围。
note.en: This example fixes today and its initial value at February 15, 2024 and starts weeks on Monday. The component retains its native Sunday WeekStart default; week numbers follow the explicit setting. Unavailable dates can be browsed but not selected as endpoints. AllowNonContiguousRanges permits unavailable interior dates, not disabled dates. Month/year views navigate; values remain Gregorian dates or ranges.

label.zh: 标记每月 20 日不可用
允许范围经过不可用日期
范围最多天数，0 不限制

name: InputDate

description.zh: 分段输入日期，也可打开日历选择。
description.en: Edit date segments or choose a date from a calendar.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

单日绑定 `Optional[Date]` 与 DateInputState；范围绑定 DateSelection 与 DateRangeInputState。未完成或被拒绝的草稿保留最后有效值。单日用 OnValueChange，范围用 OnRangeChange；清空整个范围只通知一次。

### 操作示例

调整日期步长，用上下键编辑；开启日历后选择日期。限制范围设为 2024 年 2–3 月，可将每月 20 日设为不可用。切换自定义分隔内容、头像、加载位置和高亮，观察外观。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Bind an Optional[Date] and DateInputState for one date, or DateSelection and DateRangeInputState for a range. Incomplete or rejected drafts retain the last accepted value. Use OnValueChange for one date and OnRangeChange for a range; clearing both endpoints sends one range notification.

### Try the controls

Change the day step and use Up/Down, or enable the calendar. Bounds restrict values to February–March 2024; the 20th can be unavailable. Try the custom separator, avatar, loader position and highlight.

note.zh: 只读仍允许导航与复制。ShowCalendar 默认 false，HideCalendar 优先；Calendar 的范围规则也用于分段输入。Calendar.OnChange 在范围中保留为兼容通知，单日中仅通知日历操作。PlaceholderValue 用于空段的初始调整；字符串 Placeholder、Password、MaxLength 不适用。仅支持完整公历日期，不含时刻或时区。
note.en: Read-only fields still allow navigation and copying. ShowCalendar defaults to false and HideCalendar overrides it. Calendar range constraints also apply to segment edits. Calendar.OnChange remains a legacy range notification; for one date it reports calendar actions only. PlaceholderValue seeds empty segments; string Placeholder, Password and MaxLength do not apply. Values are full Gregorian dates without a time or time zone.

name: InputTime

description.zh: 分段输入时、分、秒，支持 12 或 24 小时制。
description.en: Edit hours, minutes and seconds in 12- or 24-hour format.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

绑定 `Optional[ClockTime]` 与 TimeInputState。TwelveHour 未设置时采用区域小时制，显式 false 使用 24 小时制。Granularity 可选择小时、分钟或秒，未设置时由 Seconds 决定。

### 操作示例

分钟以指定步长循环；开启 StepSnapping 后，离开已编辑分段时对齐步长。显示精度变化保留隐藏单位，并把焦点移到仍可见的分段，不触发值通知。有效范围示例为 09:00–17:30。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Bind Optional[ClockTime] and TimeInputState. Unset TwelveHour follows the regional hour cycle; explicit false selects 24-hour time. Granularity chooses hours, minutes or seconds; when unset, Seconds determines the precision.

### Try the controls

Minutes cycle by the configured step. With StepSnapping, leaving an edited segment rounds it to the nearest step. Changing precision preserves hidden units and moves focus to a visible segment without notifying a value change. The optional valid interval is 09:00–17:30.

note.zh: 越界或不可用时间保留为草稿，不覆盖有效值。Min/Max 包含边界，比较完整时间，包括隐藏单位。仅小时输入使用 HH 或 hh AM/PM；其他精度使用 HH:MM[:SS]。当前提供单个时刻，可用两个 InputTime 和应用校验组合范围；不含日期、毫秒或时区。
note.en: Out-of-range or unavailable edits remain drafts without replacing the accepted value. Min/Max are inclusive and compare the full time, including hidden units. Hour-only input uses HH or hh AM/PM; other precisions use HH:MM[:SS]. The model represents one time of day; compose two InputTime fields with application validation for a range. Dates, milliseconds and time zones are not included.

name: ColorPicker

description.zh: 通过颜色面板、色板或数值选择颜色。
description.en: Choose a color from a panel, swatches or numeric values.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

绑定 `ui.Color` 与持久的 ColorPickerState。颜色平面、横向色相与透明度滑条、HEX / HEXA、色板及 RGBA 数值共享同一个颜色。五档尺寸改变实际选择区和字段尺寸，默认 MD 为 168 DIP 正方形。

### 操作示例

编辑颜色并比较当前值与最近一次通知。Throttle 默认 50 毫秒，只合并 OnChange，绑定颜色即时更新；设置 0 可接收每次实际变化。外部设置颜色不通知，重新填入原通道值也不通知。可切换部件样式和禁用状态。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Bind ui.Color and persistent ColorPickerState. The SV area, horizontal hue and opacity tracks, HEX/HEXA, swatches and RGBA fields share one color. Five sizes change the actual picker and fields; MD defaults to a 168 DIP square.

### Try the controls

Compare the current value with the last notification. Throttle defaults to 50 ms and coalesces OnChange only; the bound color updates immediately. Set zero for every actual change. External assignments and restoring an unchanged channel do not notify. Try the part styles and disabled state.

note.zh: 原生面板保留 MyGo 的横向轨道、透明度和色板布局。Root / Panel / Body / Item / Label 可配置；内部 SV、轨道和 HEX 部件未公开。颜色由 ui.Color 表示，字符串格式化由应用负责。编辑通道会按 sRGB 重建颜色；不提供广色域编辑、HSL/CMYK/Lab 文本输入或屏幕取色。 RTL 下原生颜色面板保持 LTR，使输入位置与渐变、滑块一致；RGBA 字段继承表单方向。
note.en: The native panel keeps MyGo’s horizontal tracks, opacity and swatches. Root, Panel, Body, Item and Label are configurable; internal SV, track and HEX parts are not exposed. ui.Color is the model, so string formatting belongs to the application. Channel edits rebuild an sRGB color; wide-gamut editing, HSL/CMYK/Lab text input and screen picking are not provided. In RTL, the native color panel stays LTR so input matches its gradients and thumbs; RGBA fields follow the form direction.

name: Table

description.zh: 按行列展示数据，支持排序、选择和滚动。
description.en: Display rows and columns with sorting, selection and scrolling.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 TableState.SetRows 设置数据，每行必须有稳定且唯一的 ID。Value 提供文字，Compare 定义排序，Cell 自定义单元格；Sortable 可显式关闭排序。清除排序恢复最近一次 SetRows 的输入顺序。List.SortBy 指向持久排序列表时启用多列排序，Sort 同步第一项。ManualSorting 保留输入顺序，由应用根据排序状态获取数据。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Project 表头切换排序，选择一行后按 Enter，查看通知和激活 ID。
2. 开启多列排序，按住 Shift 点击 Length；点击 Restore input order 恢复输入顺序。
3. 开启 Loading，原有数据仍保留；同时开启 Empty data，观察加载内容。关闭 Loading 后显示空状态。
4. 调整高度、列宽、RTL 或可见标题，查看布局与选择是否保留。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Set data with TableState.SetRows and stable, unique row IDs. Value supplies text, Compare defines sorting, and Cell customizes cells; Sortable can explicitly disable sorting. Clearing sorting restores the latest SetRows input order. Point List.SortBy at a persistent slice for multi-column sorting; Sort mirrors its first entry. ManualSorting preserves input order so the application can fetch data for the requested sort.

### Try the preview

1. Click Project to change sorting, select a row and press Enter, then inspect notifications and the activated ID.
2. Enable multi-column sorting and Shift-click Length. Choose Restore input order to reset sorting.
3. Enable Loading to keep existing rows with an indicator; also enable Empty data to see loading content. Turn Loading off to show the empty state.
4. Adjust height, column widths, RTL or the visible caption and check layout and selection.

note.zh: 表头固定在内部滚动区域上方，始终使用原生虚拟列表。Fixed 只禁止移动列和调整列宽。表头不是独立键盘焦点，示例提供排序按钮。OnSelectionChange 返回选中 ID，OnActivate 在 Enter 或双击时触发；它们与 Nuxt 的行点击 select 事件不同。筛选、分页和数据请求由应用负责；冻结列、多层表头、行展开及分组聚合尚未提供。
note.en: The header stays above the internal scrolling body and native virtualization is always enabled. Fixed only prevents column movement and resizing. Headers are not separate keyboard stops, so this example provides sorting buttons. OnSelectionChange reports selected IDs; OnActivate runs on Enter or double-click. These differ from Nuxt’s row-click select event. Filtering, pagination and requests belong to the application; pinned columns, grouped headers, expanded rows and aggregation are not provided.

name: Tree

description.zh: 展开层级数据，并选择其中的节点。
description.en: Expand hierarchical data and select its nodes.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

SetNodes 按稳定且唯一的 ID 建立节点索引。Selection 保存选择，Outline.Open 保存展开项，Active 为键盘高亮；数据改变时才调用 SetNodes。默认单选，点击行会选择并切换展开，Enter / Space 只选择。OnSelect / OnToggle 可取消，OnChange / OnExpandedChange 分别报告实际选择与展开变化。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 src，或聚焦后用左右方向键展开和折叠，查看通知计数。
2. 开启多选和父子联动，再开启自定义内容；只选部分子项时父节点显示 Mixed。关闭联动后不再显示部分选中状态。
3. 开启保护 src，确认选择和展开均可被取消；节点自身的处理器优先于全局处理器。
4. 展开 Remote files，再点击 Complete empty load，观察加载提示和默认图标消失。先点 Collapse remote 再返回结果，会显示过期结果被拒绝。
5. 切换 RTL、Nested、尺寸和主题，检查内容、焦点和稳定选择。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

SetNodes indexes nodes by stable, unique IDs. Selection stores selection, Outline.Open stores expansion, and Active is the keyboard highlight. Call SetNodes only when data changes. By default, row clicks select and toggle; Enter/Space only select. OnSelect/OnToggle can cancel, while OnChange/OnExpandedChange report actual selection and expansion changes.

### Try the preview

1. Click src or focus it and use Left/Right to expand and collapse; inspect the event counts.
2. Enable multiple selection, linkage and custom content. A partly selected parent shows Mixed; disabling linkage removes that state.
3. Protect src to cancel its selection and expansion. A node-specific handler takes precedence over the global handler.
4. Expand Remote files and choose Complete empty load to remove its loading hint and fallback icons. Collapse remote before returning a result to see stale completion rejected.
5. Change RTL, Nested, size and theme to inspect content, focus and stable selection.

note.zh: 父子联动只处理已加载的可用节点，禁用节点会阻断联动，后续加载的子项不自动继承选择。部分选中只用于多选：BubbleSelect 按子项混合状态判断，只有 PropagateSelect 时要求父项已选中。Nested 改变竖线、背景和点击区域，两种模式均使用原生虚拟列表。首尾内容构建器替换默认图标，应只放展示内容；交互仍由整行和键盘处理。空分支保留展开状态，但不自动显示文件夹和箭头。
note.en: Linkage covers loaded, enabled nodes, stops at disabled nodes, and does not select children loaded later. Mixed state applies only in multiple mode: BubbleSelect checks mixed descendants; PropagateSelect alone also requires a selected parent. Nested changes guides, backgrounds and hit areas; both modes use native virtualization. Leading/trailing builders replace default icons and should contain display content only; rows and the keyboard retain interaction. Empty branches retain expansion state without fallback folder/chevron icons.

name: CommandPalette

description.zh: 搜索分组命令，进入子级，并执行选中的操作。
description.en: Search grouped commands, enter nested actions, and run a result.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 NewCommandIndex 建立不可变索引，再交给持久保存的 CommandPaletteState。数据改变时调用 SetIndex；关闭状态也要调用 CommandPalette，以便注册快捷键和恢复焦点。OnSelect 接收已执行的命令 ID，OnSelectEvent 可提前取消。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Open commands，搜索 invoice 或 Local，查看描述和后缀的匹配高亮。文件命令集中显示在同一组。
2. 打开 Appearance options，查看子级占位文字；搜索框为空时按 Backspace 返回。
3. Protected command 默认取消执行。关闭保护后启用保持打开，可重复执行并查看计数。
4. 启用手动搜索，输入两次不同的查询词，再用 Try stale result 验证旧票据失效，用 Complete search 返回当前结果。
5. 切换延时、尺寸、输入框、图标、RTL 和主题，查看布局与键盘行为。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build an immutable index with NewCommandIndex and assign it to persistent CommandPaletteState. Call SetIndex when data changes. Keep rendering CommandPalette while closed so shortcuts and return focus work. OnSelect receives executed IDs; OnSelectEvent can cancel first.

### Try the preview

1. Click Open commands and search invoice or Local to highlight descriptions and suffixes. File commands remain in one group.
2. Open Appearance options to see its placeholder; press Backspace with an empty search to go back.
3. Protected command cancels by default. Disable protection and keep the palette open to execute repeatedly and inspect the count.
4. Enable manual search, enter two queries, then use Try stale result to reject the old ticket and Complete search to deliver the current result.
5. Change delay, size, input, icons, RTL and theme to inspect layout and keyboard behavior.

note.zh: 本组件是原生命令启动器，默认执行后关闭，始终使用虚拟列表；不提供 Vue 的嵌入式多选模型或路由属性。默认搜索 label、description、suffix、keywords，最多显示 200 条；FilterFields / IgnoreFilter 仅控制内置搜索，自定义 Search 负责筛选。SearchDelay 只延迟查询编辑，旧请求立即取消。更换同类 Search 回调后调用 Refresh，离开视图或关闭窗口时调用 Close。此预览关闭默认快捷键。
note.en: This native command launcher closes after execution by default and always virtualizes results. Embedded Vue multiple selection and routing props are not provided. Built-in search covers label, description, suffix and keywords, with up to 200 results. FilterFields/IgnoreFilter affect only built-in search; custom Search handles filtering. SearchDelay delays query edits while canceling old requests immediately. Call Refresh after replacing a custom Search callback, and Close on unmount or window close. This preview disables the default shortcut.

name: NavigationMenu

description.zh: 提供应用的主要导航和子级菜单。
description.en: Provide primary navigation and nested destinations.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 active ID 保存当前位置，NavigationState.Expanded 保存纵向分支的展开状态。OnNavigate 执行页面切换，OnSelect 可取消叶项导航，OnExpandedChange 报告用户展开变化。组件不解析 URL；父项用于展开子级。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 选择 Projects，查看活动 ID 和导航次数。
2. 打开 Settings，再选择 Protected destination，确认保护开关可以取消导航并保留菜单。
3. 启用纵向导航，在 Settings 与 Help center 之间比较 Single、Collapsible 和展开通知。
4. 切换 Compact、Tooltip、Popover 与 RTL，检查提示、侧向弹层和返回焦点；横向模式忽略 Compact。
5. 切换颜色、pill / link、Highlight，查看活动样式、头像、状态圆点、徽章和单项字重。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep the current destination in an active ID and vertical expansion in NavigationState.Expanded. OnNavigate switches pages, OnSelect can cancel leaf navigation, and OnExpandedChange reports user expansion changes. The component does not resolve URLs; parents open their children.

### Try the preview

1. Select Projects and inspect the active ID and action count.
2. Open Settings and select Protected destination to cancel navigation while keeping the menu open.
3. Enable vertical navigation and compare Single, Collapsible and expansion events between Settings and Help center.
4. Change Compact, Tooltip, Popover and RTL to inspect hints, side popovers and return focus. Horizontal mode ignores Compact.
5. Change color, pill/link and Highlight to inspect active styles, avatars, chips, badges and item font weight.

note.zh: 默认横向排列，Primary 颜色、Soft（pill）样式。Compact 仅对纵向生效；紧凑导航的 Tooltip / Popover 保留原生默认 true，上游默认 false。DefaultOpen 只初始化新节点，外部修改 Expanded 不发送展开通知；Single 按同级分支限制展开，Collapsible 仅在 Single 下限制收起。横向子级使用原生 DropdownMenu，没有网页的共享 mega menu 视口、自动路由匹配或 hover 延时模型。
note.en: Defaults to horizontal, Primary and Soft (pill). Compact only affects vertical navigation. Compact Tooltip/Popover retain the native true defaults, while upstream defaults to false. DefaultOpen initializes new nodes only; external Expanded edits are silent. Single limits sibling expansion; Collapsible only restricts closing in Single mode. Horizontal children use native DropdownMenu rather than a shared web mega-menu viewport, automatic route matching or its hover-delay model.

name: Drawer

description.zh: 从底部打开面板，并用手柄调整高度。
description.en: Open a bottom panel and adjust its height with a handle.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

保存 DrawerState，用 Open 控制显示，Snap 选择停靠点。SnapPoints 是可用窗口高度的递增比例；Inset 会先扣除外边距。关闭状态也要继续调用 Drawer，以便退出动画和焦点恢复。Handle 控制独立手柄，CloseButton 默认 false。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Open drawer，编辑草稿；拖动手柄，或聚焦后用 Up/Down、Home/End 调整高度。
2. 在首个或末个停靠点重复按 Home/End，Changes 不会继续增加。
3. 关闭 Dismissible 后尝试 Escape、外部点击或向下拖动，查看 Prevented 次数；Done 仍可由应用直接关闭。
4. 切换 Handle、Inset、关闭按钮和自定义指示条；将标题清空后，手柄与面板仍有本地化名称。
5. 关闭并重新打开，检查草稿、停靠位置与返回焦点。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep DrawerState persistent: Open controls visibility and Snap selects a stop. SnapPoints are ascending fractions of available window height; Inset subtracts the margins first. Render while closed for exit animation and return focus. Handle controls the independent handle; CloseButton defaults to false.

### Try the preview

1. Click Open drawer and edit the draft. Drag the handle or focus it and use Up/Down and Home/End.
2. Repeat Home/End at a boundary; Changes does not increase again.
3. Disable Dismissible and try Escape, an outside click or a closing drag; inspect Prevented. Done still closes directly from the application.
4. Change Handle, Inset, close button and indicator styling. Clear the title to retain localized panel and handle names.
5. Close and reopen to check the draft, snap index and return focus.

note.zh: 这是只能从底部打开、仅由手柄拖动的原生面板。SnapPoints 只接受 (0,1] 的比例，不接受 px 字符串；默认 0.5 / 0.85。吸附高度立即切换，出入场沿用 Slideover。DismissDistance / DismissVelocity 是原生关闭阈值，0 使用默认值；不等同于 Vaul 的 closeThreshold。Overlay=false 只隐藏背景，仍保留模态交互限制。Width、MaxHeight、Fullscreen 在本组件不生效。

DismissDistance/DismissVelocity are native thresholds with 0 selecting defaults, not Vaul closeThreshold equivalents. Overlay=false only hides the backdrop, retaining modal interaction rules. Width, MaxHeight and Fullscreen do not apply.

name: FileUpload

description.zh: 选择文件，并显示文件状态和上传进度。
description.en: Select files and display their status and upload progress.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

FileUploadState 保存文件队列，应用通过 Begin / Report 管理实际传输。Rules 检查类型、大小和数量，拒绝项保留原因；OnChange 仅在用户选择或移除使队列变化时通知，OnReject 报告本次新增的拒绝项。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Project files 添加模拟元数据，查看 Changes 和 Rejected。重复选择相同文件不会再次通知。
2. 将选择结果改成 cancel 或 error，重新选择；取消和错误不改变队列。
3. 移除文件后，键盘焦点返回选择入口。切换列表、网格和列表位置，检查数据保留。
4. 关闭 FileImage 只隐藏预览配件；关闭 Preview 隐藏整个文件列表。切换图标、高亮和自定义部件查看外观。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

FileUploadState holds a queue; the application implements transfers through Begin / Report. Rules checks type, size and count, retaining rejected rows with reasons. OnChange reports user selections or removals that change the queue; OnReject reports newly rejected files.

### Try the preview

1. Click Project files to add simulated metadata and inspect Changes and Rejected. Selecting the same files again does not notify.
2. Set the selection result to cancel or error and choose again; neither changes the queue.
3. Remove a file to return focus to the picker. Change the layout and list position while retaining the data.
4. FileImage hides only the supplied preview accessory; Preview hides the whole list. Try the icon, highlight and custom part settings.

note.zh: 示例的 Choose 返回模拟元数据，不打开原生文件选择框、不读取文件内容，也不上传文件。Go 保留多文件队列；Dialog.Multiple 仅控制原生对话框单次多选，Rules.MaxFiles 控制已接受文件总数。列表位置只影响 UploadArea / UploadList；网格保留文件名、状态与进度，和 Nuxt 的图片网格布局不同。应用负责预览图片、文件流与传输，并在隐藏或卸载时调用 Dispose。
note.en: Choose returns simulated metadata: no native dialog, file content reads or uploads. Go keeps a queue; Dialog.Multiple controls one native dialog selection and Rules.MaxFiles limits accepted files in the queue. Position affects UploadArea / UploadList only. The native grid retains names, status and progress, unlike Nuxt’s image grid. The application owns preview images, streams and transfers and calls Dispose on hiding or unmounting.

name: Chart

description.zh: 用折线、柱状、面积或扇区图展示数据。
description.en: Display data as lines, bars, areas or slices.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

持久保存 ChartState，通过 SetCategories、SetData、SetTimeData 或 SetSlices 更新数据。默认图例只在系列或扇区多于一个时显示；Height 默认 300，未设置高度时可使用 AspectRatio。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 聚焦图表，用左右键和 Home/End 查看数据，再按 Enter/Space 激活，观察通知次数。
2. 点击 Views 或 Visits 图例隐藏系列，再在数据配置中调整系列顺序，检查显隐状态仍跟随 ID。
3. 在数据配置中只保留一个系列，观察自动图例隐藏；显式开启 Legend 可继续显示。
4. 切换坐标轴、数据点、提示、配色、RTL 与图形类型。圆环可以调整 Thickness，并显示中心内容。
5. 在数据配置中清空系列，再恢复，检查本地化空状态和键盘操作。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep ChartState persistent and update it with SetCategories, SetData, SetTimeData or SetSlices. Automatic legends appear only for multiple series or slices. Height defaults to 300; AspectRatio applies when height is unset.

### Try the preview

1. Focus the chart, inspect values with arrows and Home/End, then activate with Enter/Space and inspect notification counts.
2. Hide Views or Visits, then reorder series in the data editor; visibility follows IDs.
3. Keep one series in the data editor to hide the automatic legend, or explicitly enable Legend.
4. Try axes, points, tooltips, colors, RTL and chart types. Donuts support Thickness and center content.
5. Empty and restore the series in the data editor to check the localized empty state and keyboard interaction.

note.zh: 参考 Nuxt UI 4.12.0 的 TanStack Charts；Go 使用 MyGo 绘制，保留散点图、饼图、有序数值/时间轴及交互图例。ChartSelection 标识整行 X 或一个扇区，不提供 Web 引擎的原始 point/group 对象。YLabel 在图表上方横向显示；圆环显式 DonutInnerRadius 优先于 Thickness。高度包含坐标区，图例、轴标题和状态文字另占空间。
note.en: Based on Nuxt UI 4.12.0 with TanStack Charts; Go uses MyGo and retains scatter/pie charts, ordered numeric/time axes and interactive legends. ChartSelection identifies an X row or slice, not raw Web engine point/group objects. YLabel is horizontal above the plot. Explicit DonutInnerRadius overrides Thickness. Height covers the plot and axes; legends, titles and status text use additional space.

guide.zh:

### 在预览中试一试

1. 用圆点、箭头或方向键切换，观察 Changes。
2. 输入草稿后切换方向或布局；移除当前项，再恢复，草稿仍由应用保存。
3. 开启循环并拖到末项，继续向后拖不会绕回首项；关闭 WatchDrag 后键盘仍可操作。
4. 启用 Autoplay；StopOnInteraction 默认 true，箭头、键盘和完成拖动会暂停，可用 Play 恢复。圆点只定位，悬停与组件内焦点临时暂停播放。
5. 查看自定义大小、图标、头像及圆点样式，切换 RTL 检查方向。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep CarouselState persistent and control position through Index. Give items stable IDs and synchronous Build callbacks. Arrows and Dots default to false; this example explicitly shows dots. Wrap loops buttons, keys and autoplay while drags remain bounded.

### Try the preview

1. Navigate with dots, arrows or keys and inspect Changes.
2. Edit a draft, change orientation, remove the current item and restore it; the application retains drafts.
3. Enable wrapping and drag to the final slide; another forward drag stays there. Disable WatchDrag while retaining keyboard navigation.
4. Enable Autoplay. StopOnInteraction defaults to true: arrows, keys and completed drags pause it; use Play to resume. Dots only seek; hover and focus within the component pause temporarily.
5. Try custom button sizes, icons, an avatar and dot styling, then inspect RTL navigation.

note.zh: 这是原生单页轮播，没有 Embla 的自由拖拽、滑动组、媒体查询、惯性持续时间或插件 API。Active 控制自动播放的外部活动状态，不会禁用手动操作；它与 Embla 的 active 含义不同。当前项及相邻项会执行 Build，相邻项禁用交互；在动作中启动业务任务。自动播放遵守窗口、可见性与减少动态效果设置。
note.en: This native single-page carousel has no Embla drag-free, slide grouping, media query, physics duration or plugin API. Active gates external activity for autoplay and does not disable manual navigation, unlike Embla active. Build runs for the current item and its neighbors; neighbors are disabled. Start business work from actions. Autoplay respects window activity, visibility and reduced motion.

name: Marquee

description.zh: 连续滚动展示文字或其他非交互内容。
description.en: Continuously scroll text or other display-only content.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Repeat 默认重复 4 份，显式 0 不构建内容，1 份滚动时可能出现空白。Speed 默认每秒 32 DIP，Gap 默认 64 DIP。内容回调只放展示元素；Body 配置每份内容的样式。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整重复次数，比较 0、1 和 4 份；切换方向、RTL、反向与两端渐隐。
2. 点击 Pause / resume，或聚焦滚动区域后按 Space。开启悬停暂停后，移出指针再继续。
3. 点击 Replace content 更新内容并重置位置；禁用父容器会停止运动。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Repeat defaults to four copies; explicit zero builds no content and a single copy may leave an empty interval. Speed defaults to 32 DIP/s and Gap to 64 DIP. Keep the callback presentation-only; Body styles each content copy.

### Try the preview

1. Compare zero, one and four copies, then change orientation, RTL, reverse and edge fading.
2. Use Pause / resume or focus the region and press Space. Enable pause on hover and move the pointer away to continue.
3. Replace content to reset the phase. Disabling the parent stops motion.

note.zh: Repeat 是内容回调的构建次数，不要在其中放输入框、按钮或业务副作用。焦点、暂停状态、Active=false、父级禁用、不可见（包括滚出或被裁剪出可见区域，以及保持挂载的隐藏面板）和减少动态效果都会停止运动。内容在只重绘的帧中移动，视图约每秒构建一次；MarqueeState.Offset 是最近一次构建时的位置。原生使用 DIP/s；上游 CSS 默认每周期 20 秒，两者单位不同。网站最多允许 100 份内容；重复内容的读屏表现仍需在目标辅助工具验证。
note.en: Repeat is the callback count: avoid inputs, buttons and business side effects. Focus, pause, Active=false, disabled ancestors, invisibility (including being scrolled or clipped out of view, or a hidden kept-mounted panel) and reduced motion stop animation. The content moves in frames that only repaint, so the view builds about once a second, and MarqueeState.Offset is the phase as of the last build. Native speed uses DIP/s, while upstream CSS defaults to 20 seconds per cycle. The website permits up to 100 copies. Repeated content still requires target screen-reader validation.

name: Splitter

description.zh: 拖动分隔条，调整两个面板的大小。
description.en: Resize two panels by dragging their divider.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Splitter 绑定第一面板的 float32 尺寸，默认单位 DIP，Percent=true 时为百分比。Orientation 或 Vertical 选择方向；Min、Max 和显式 KeyboardResizeBy 与绑定值使用相同单位。未设置键盘步长时，每次移动 10 DIP。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 拖动分隔条，或聚焦后按方向键、Home、End。到达 30–70 的边界后继续按键，变化次数保持不变。
2. 锁定分隔条后，继续编辑 Pane draft；禁用父容器则会同时禁用输入。
3. 切换方向、RTL 与样式，检查草稿保留。External maximum 直接设置模型，不发送 OnChange。
4. 开启嵌套面板，检查横纵分隔线在交点相接。分别拖动两条线，编辑草稿和备注；切换 RTL 后交点仍应连续。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Splitter binds the first pane size as float32 in DIP, or a percentage with Percent=true. Orientation or Vertical selects the axis. Min, Max and explicit KeyboardResizeBy use the bound unit; the unset keyboard step moves ten DIPs.

### Try the preview

1. Drag or focus the divider and use arrows, Home and End. Repeating a key at the 30–70 limits does not increment Changes.
2. Lock the divider and continue editing Pane draft; disabling the parent also disables the editor.
3. Switch orientation, RTL and styles while retaining the draft. External maximum sets the model without OnChange.
4. Enable nested panels and inspect the continuous divider junction. Drag each divider and edit the draft and notes; the junction also joins in RTL.

note.zh: Disabled 只锁定分隔条。当前为两个面板，支持嵌套，不提供多面板协调、折叠停靠或自动保存。比例值和最小/最大值约束模型；面板仍保留原生 40 DIP 最小尺寸，极窄空间由布局收缩。布局只为可见分隔线保留 1 DIP；8 DIP 拖拽区域覆盖两侧边缘，不挤开面板。SeparatorSlot 和 Indicator 分别设置拖拽区域和线条外观。
note.en: Disabled locks only the divider. Two panels and nested splitters are supported; coordinated multi-panel layouts, collapse/docking and auto-save are not provided. Value constraints apply to the model; panes retain the native 40-DIP minimum and shrink in very small layouts. Only the one-DIP line occupies layout space. An eight-DIP hit area overlaps the pane edges without separating them. SeparatorSlot and Indicator style the hit area and line.

name: Sidebar

description.zh: 为应用提供可收起、可调宽的侧边栏。
description.en: Add a collapsible, resizable application sidebar.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Sidebar 提供标题、描述、标题操作、滚动正文和底部。用 collapsed 保存桌面收起状态，SidebarState 保存宽度和窄窗口开关；这些状态由应用持有。Actions 在展开或窄窗口菜单中显示，HeaderContent 可以替换默认标题和描述。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 编辑 Sidebar draft，再收起、展开，检查草稿保留；拖动或双击边缘调整、恢复宽度。
2. 点击标题操作按钮查看计数，比较区域样式、RTL 和左右布局。
3. 将断点设得比预览区域宽，打开菜单并选择其他页面，检查关闭后返回打开按钮。比较 Slideover、Modal 和 Drawer。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Sidebar provides a title, description, header actions, scrollable body and footer. Keep collapsed in application state and use SidebarState for width and the narrow-window menu. Actions appear while expanded or mobile; HeaderContent replaces the default title and description.

### Try the preview

1. Edit Sidebar draft and collapse/expand without losing the draft. Drag or double-click the edge to resize or reset.
2. Activate the header action and compare region styling, RTL and sides.
3. Set the breakpoint wider than the preview. Open the menu, choose a different page and check return focus. Compare Slideover, Modal and Drawer.

note.zh: 组件默认不启用断点和调宽；本例启用调宽并限制在 160–360 DIP，收起宽 64 DIP。桌面 collapsed 和窄窗口 Open 独立，默认图标宽度收起与上游 offcanvas 不同。直接赋值不发通知；跨断点重建保留应用模型，控件局部滚动和选择不会迁移。完全隐藏所有内部入口时应提供外部按钮及 ReturnFocus。原生没有 floating/inset 变体、点击折叠 rail 或任意 menu 配置对象。
note.en: The component defaults to no breakpoint and no resizing; this example enables 160–360 DIP resizing and a 64-DIP compact width. Desktop collapsed and mobile Open are independent; native icon-width collapse differs from upstream offcanvas. External assignments are silent. Breakpoint remounts retain application models, but not widget-local scrolling or selections. Supply an external opener and ReturnFocus when hiding every internal control. Native floating/inset variants, a click-to-collapse rail and arbitrary menu option objects are not provided.

name: Header

description.zh: 在内容区顶部显示标题、说明和主要操作。
description.en: Show a title, description and primary actions above the content.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

HeaderLayout 显示 Title、原生扩展 Description、Leading 和 Actions。Leading、Body、Label、Description、Actions 都有实际样式部件；区域使用稳定身份，切换前导内容不会重建动作中的编辑器。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 编辑 Header draft，切换前导图标和样式，检查草稿保留。
2. 点击菜单按钮，选择 Header menu settings。页面名称更新，菜单自动关闭并把焦点还给按钮。
3. 切换 RTL 或输入长标题，比较换行和操作区域。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

HeaderLayout renders Title, native Description, Leading and Actions. Leading, Body, Label, Description and Actions are actual style parts. Stable region identities retain action editors when leading content changes.

### Try the preview

1. Edit Header draft and toggle the leading icon or styles without losing the draft.
2. Open the menu and choose Header menu settings. The page changes, the menu closes and focus returns to its opener.
3. Compare RTL, long titles and wrapping.

note.zh: HeaderLayout 是原生应用标题区，标题默认为空，不自动生成网页首页链接、粘性定位或移动菜单。本例用 Sidebar 组合菜单；断点 2000 DIP 用于在常见预览宽度下展示弹层。mode、menu、open 和路由自动关闭不属于 HeaderOptions，菜单状态由组合的 Sidebar 负责。
note.en: HeaderLayout is a native application header. Its title defaults to empty; it does not create a home link, sticky positioning or a mobile menu automatically. This example composes Sidebar with a 2000-DIP breakpoint to show its overlay at normal preview widths. Mode, menu, open and route auto-close are not HeaderOptions; the composed Sidebar owns menu state.

name: Footer

description.zh: 在内容区底部显示说明和次要操作。
description.en: Show explanatory text and secondary actions below the content.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

FooterLayout 用 Text 显示说明，Actions 构建操作。Root、Label 和 Actions 分别配置容器、文字和操作区域；操作内部默认间距 6 DIP，空间不足时可以换行。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Review 和 Help，查看实际通知次数和结果。
2. 开启动作样式，检查背景、内边距和按钮间距。
3. 输入更长的中文文字并切换 RTL，比较文字与操作区的排列。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

FooterLayout uses Text for copy and Actions for controls. Root, Label and Actions style the container, text and action region. Actions use a six-DIP gap and wrap when needed.

### Try the preview

1. Activate Review and Help and inspect callback counts and results.
2. Enable action styling to compare its background, padding and button gap.
3. Enter longer text and switch RTL to inspect layout.

note.zh: 原生 API 使用 Text 和 Actions，不提供网页的 left/default/right/top/bottom 插槽或 UContainer 断点重排。需要多区页脚时可用原生布局组合。默认没有顶部边线，Root 内边距为水平 20、垂直 12 DIP。
note.en: The native API uses Text and Actions rather than web left/default/right/top/bottom slots or UContainer breakpoint reordering. Compose additional regions with native layouts. The footer has no default top border and uses 20-DIP horizontal and 12-DIP vertical root padding.

name: FooterColumns

description.zh: 按栏目排列页脚链接。
description.en: Arrange footer links into columns.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

列和导航项分别使用稳定 ID。Title 显示列标题，Items 使用 Label、Icon、Active、Disabled、OnSelect 和单项 Decoration。OnSelect 在 OnNavigate 前调用，PreventDefault 可以取消导航。默认列间距 32 DIP，标题与列表间距 24 DIP，链接间距 16 DIP。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 选择 Examples 或指南，查看活动颜色和两种通知计数；禁用项不执行回调。
2. 开启取消导航，选择项后 Selects 增加，Navigations 和 Active 保持不变。
3. 比较 RTL、窄列和样式。完整数据配置可以更改列顺序、标题和单项状态；保留 ID 以保持控件身份。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Give columns and links stable IDs. Title names a column; Items use Label, Icon, Active, Disabled, OnSelect and item Decoration. OnSelect runs before OnNavigate and PreventDefault cancels navigation. Default gaps are 32 DIP between columns, 24 between titles and lists, and 16 between links.

### Try the preview

1. Select Examples or the guide and inspect active colors and callback counts. Disabled entries do nothing.
2. Cancel selection: Selects increases while Navigations and Active stay unchanged.
3. Compare RTL, narrow columns and styles. Full data configuration can change column order, labels and item state; keep IDs stable.

note.zh: MinColumnWidth 默认 160 DIP，非正值采用默认，非有限值无效；列和链接受可用宽度约束，长链接单行省略。NavigationItem 中的嵌套子项、分组、描述、头像、徽章、Tooltip 和 Popover 不用于 FooterColumns。原生按 ID 通知应用，不包含 URL、路由匹配、外链标记或左右附加区域。
note.en: MinColumnWidth defaults to 160 DIP; nonpositive values use the default and nonfinite values are invalid. Columns and links fit available width and long link labels truncate. NavigationItem children, groups, descriptions, avatars, badges, Tooltip and Popover do not apply here. Native links notify the application by ID; URL routing, external-link indicators and extra left/right regions are not included.
